DensityMode.description: Control sizes by the input the player holds: auto picks touch sizes on a coarse pointer or a play surface under 768 px, mouse sizes otherwise.

x-og-variants.auto: Touch sizes on a coarse pointer or a narrow surface, mouse sizes otherwise.
x-og-variants.mouse: A mouse and keyboard: the tightest controls.
x-og-variants.pad: A gamepad across a room: larger controls, rows and gutters that read from a couch.
x-og-variants.touch: A finger: every control at least 44 CSS px.

ThemeColor.description: A colour role of the UI style in effect (the game's style, or the default style before it picks one).

x-og-variants.backdrop: The screen behind the UI where nothing else is.
x-og-variants.well: A recessed ground inside a panel: wells, map frames, empty slots.
x-og-variants.lineStrong: Stronger frames: high contrast, map borders, scrollbars.
x-og-variants.inkMuted: Secondary ink: captions, keys, inactive tabs.
x-og-variants.inkFaint: The faintest ink that still reads: placeholders, hints.
x-og-variants.inkInverse: Ink on a ground of ink (a selected chip).
x-og-variants.control: Neutral control fills: secondary buttons, tracks, fields.
x-og-variants.controlStrong: A neutral control hovered or pressed; selection.
x-og-variants.primary: The one directed action: primary buttons, a slider's fill, a switch that is on, the caret.
x-og-variants.highlight: Emphasised ink: a speaker's name, a price, a link, the player's map dot.
x-og-variants.selection: The selected row, tab or card, independent of primary actions.
x-og-variants.accent: Decorative emphasis, independent of primary and selection.
x-og-variants.sceneInk: Scheme-aware text drawn over the scene.
x-og-variants.sceneShadow: Separation shadow under text over the scene.
x-og-variants.focus: The focus ring of key and pad navigation.
x-og-variants.hud: HUD capsules over the game (scores, timers, toasts).
x-og-variants.gold: Currency: coins, gold, prices that can be paid.

TypeStepName.description: A step of the style's type ramp.

x-og-variants.caption: A step of the ramp.
x-og-variants.hero: The largest typography role, above display; displayXl2 is its legacy alias.

SizeRange.description: The bounds of a fit or grow size.

max.description: The largest size; absent is unbounded.

PercentSize.description: A size relative to the parent.

fraction.description: The fraction of the parent's inner size.

Size.description: A size along one axis. Absent (null) is fit: the content's size.

oneOf.description: The content's size, within the range.

max.description: The largest size; absent is unbounded.

oneOf.description: The content's size, then a share of the parent's free space, within the range.

max.description: The largest size; absent is unbounded.

oneOf.description: A fraction of the parent's inner size.

fraction.description: The fraction of the parent's inner size.

Insets.description: Padding or margins on four sides.

Paint.description: A colour: a theme token, or an sRGB colour as authored (components 0 to 1), with an alpha. Neither is white.

token.description: A semantic colour of the theme.

role.description: A colour role the style declares of its own (its `roles` block, docs/ui.md §12.2: a game's corruption or faction colour) by name, when no token is given; a name the style lacks draws magenta.

color.description: An sRGB colour as authored, when no token or role is given.

ArrowClaim.description: Which arrows a focused element claims (ElementDesc.arrows); none by default.

ElementDesc.description: A container: its layout and its look.

direction.description: Which way it lays out its children.

width.description: Its width; null fits the content.

height.description: Its height; null fits the content.

align.description: Where children sit along the main axis.

wrap.description: Break a row into lines at its inner width.

scroll.description: Scroll its content vertically and clip it.

scrollX.description: Scroll its content horizontally and clip it (with scroll: both ways).

interactive.description: Report a Response from close(), as a button does.

focusable.description: With interactive: keys and pads reach it (a card, a menu item, a component's tab), it takes the focus ring, and Enter, Space and the pad's A press it, as a button. Its role is button unless og.ui.semantics gives another.

adjustable.description: With focusable: Left and Right (a pad's left and right) are its own while it has the focus: they step it (Response.adjust) instead of moving the focus, as a slider's do (a menu row opening its submenu, a carousel, a divider).

arrows.description: With focusable: the arrows (a pad's d-pad and stick) it claims one by one while it has the focus: each steps it (Response.adjust for Left and Right, Response.adjustY for Up and Down) instead of moving the focus. A grid's own cursor (an inventory, a level map) claims the ones that keep it inside, so the focus leaves it at its edges.

ownRing.description: With focusable: the component draws its own focus (a hand rings its focused card, a grid its cursor cell) while Response.ring says the ring is up; og-ui draws no ring around the element.

radius.description: Corner radius.

frame.description: The style frame its background takes (a HUD element, a card); null is a plain fill. Without a style the fill is drawn either way.

part.description: The part its style dresses it as, a selector with its variant, state and attributes (`ShopCard.frame[rarity=epic][selected]`): the style's most specific matching `dress` blocks draw it, and a part the style does not dress draws from the tokens (docs/ui.md §12.3). Overrides frame; null keeps frame's.

partClass.description: The element class whose corner, outline and elevation an undressed part takes from the tokens: panel, dialog, card, tooltip, button, field, chip, badge, tab, slot, bar, hud, avatar. Null: a decoration (a scrim, a sweep, a node's art), which takes nothing from the tokens, only what a style dresses it with; a part that is a card or a panel names its class.

aspect.description: Width over height (0: none): with the height left to fit, it is as tall as its laid-out width over this; with a fixed height and the width left to fit, as wide as the height times it.

LabelDesc.description: How a label draws its text.

step.description: The type step; null is body.

color.description: The ink; null is ink.

onScene.description: Text over the scene: uses sceneInk when color is null and draws the scheme's sceneShadow separation. A HUD plate uses background: { token: 'scenePlate' } on its container.

uppercase.description: Uppercase in the UI's locale before it is measured (Turkish i to İ, Greek without its accents), as a type role with `case upper` is; the probe and screen readers keep the source text. Never uppercase in game code: String.toUpperCase knows no locale.

nowrap.description: Keep to one line (breaking only at `\n`).

width.description: Its width; null fits the text.

heading.description: A heading: a style with a flourish frames it.

ellipsis.description: Cut with an ellipsis where the text does not fit its width: on its one line (with nowrap; the label can then shrink in a row) or on its last line (maxLines). The probe still reads the whole text.

maxLines.description: The most lines a wrapping label shows; 0 is no limit. With ellipsis the last ends in an ellipsis when text is left out.

fitMin.description: Auto-fit: where the text does not fit its width (one line with nowrap, else its words and maxLines), it takes the ramp's smaller sizes, largest first, down to this step, keeping its own step's tracking and features; at the smallest, ellipsis cuts what still does not fit. Null keeps its step. A translation longer than the source (German on a button) shrinks instead of wrapping or overflowing.

size.description: The control height.

width.description: Its width; null fits the label.

autofocus.description: Take the focus when it appears (it was not on screen the tick before) and no dialog is open: what opens takes the focus (og-ui §4), so a menu's first item answers Enter and the pad's A from its first tick.

square.description: A square of the control height with no side padding: an icon button or a one-glyph label (`+`). Overrides width.

PanelDesc.description: A card: panel, the panel radius, padded and spaced by the style.

row.description: Lay children left to right (the default is top to bottom).

width.description: Its width; null fits the content.

height.description: Its height; null fits the content.

padding.description: Space inside; null is space.lg on every side.

gap.description: Space between children; null is space.md.

align.description: Where children sit along the main axis.

ScrollAxes.description: Which ways a scroll container scrolls.

ScrollDesc.description: A scroll container: the wheel (both axes, deltaX and deltaY) or a drag scrolls it, and a released drag keeps its momentum, slowing over motion.spring.momentum's response (none under reduced motion); it clips its content; a scrollbar on each scrolling axis shows the position, and a press on one grabs and drags it. Nested containers hand off: what the innermost under the pointer cannot take (it reached its end, or does not scroll that way) goes to the one around it.

width.description: Its width; null fits the content.

height.description: Its height; null fits the content.

hideBars.description: Draws no scrollbars: a row of chips or tabs that shows its overflow by its cut edge (a resting thumb under it reads as a selection underline). It still scrolls by the wheel, a drag and focus.

fade.description: How far the content fades into `fadeInto` over an edge where more of it lies beyond, as strong as the content past that edge reaches this length (a log's top row cut mid-glyph reads as "there is more"); 0 draws no fade.

fadeInto.description: The surface the content fades into; null is panel.

ImageDesc.description: A texture region, or a solid rectangle without a texture.

texture.description: The texture; null draws a solid rectangle of the tint.

uv.description: The region drawn, [u0, v0, u1, v1] with v down; null is the whole texture.

tint.description: Multiplies the texture; null is white.

aspect.description: Width over height (0: none): with the height left to fit, the image is as tall as its laid-out width over this (a growing column keeps a picture's proportions); with a fixed height and the width left to fit, as wide as the height times it.

label.description: What a screen reader calls it (and the probe's text): a picture that means something (a portrait, a star earned) names it in the game's words; empty is decoration.

ZoomViewDesc.description: A zoomable picture (a map, an artwork): what it shows and its zoom limits.

texture.description: The picture; null draws a solid rectangle of the tint.

uv.description: The picture's region, [u0, v0, u1, v1] with v down; null is the whole texture.

tint.description: Multiplies the texture; null is white.

aspect.description: Width over height (0: none), as ImageDesc.aspect.

minZoom.description: The least zoom; 0 is 1 (the whole picture).

zoom.description: Its zoom: 1 shows the whole picture, 2 half of it each way.

centerX.description: The middle of what it shows, as a fraction of the picture's width (0.5 at rest).

centerY.description: The middle of what it shows, as a fraction of the picture's height (0.5 at rest).

width.description: Its width; null grows into the free space.

min.description: The smallest value; min equal to max (the zero value) means 0 to 1.

step.description: Snap to multiples of step from min; 0 is continuous.

placeholder.description: Shown, dimmed, while the field is empty.

maxChars.description: The most characters it takes; 0 is no limit.

invalid.description: Its text is wrong (a form's error): its frame is dressed `Field.frame[invalid]` and, undressed, takes the danger outline.

bare.description: No frame and no focus ring of its own, a small inset: a component frames it (an input with an icon and a clear button) and shows its focus.

placeholder.description: Shown, dimmed, while the area is empty.

rows.description: Lines shown at once; 0 is 4. More scroll.

maxChars.description: The most characters it takes, line breaks included; 0 is no limit.

invalid.description: Its text is wrong: its frame is dressed `Field.frame[invalid]`.

bare.description: No frame and no focus ring of its own: a component frames it.

Response.description: What happened to an element this tick. Edges (clicked, changed, submitted) are true for exactly one tick.

hovered.description: The pointer is over it and no other element holds the press.

pressed.description: The press that started on it is still held.

changed.description: Its value changed (slider, toggle, text field).

focused.description: It has focus: a text field being edited, or the control keyboard and gamepad navigation landed on.

submitted.description: Enter was pressed in it (text field).

dropped.description: A list row or grid cell a press started on was released over this one: that row's or cell's index (drag and drop).

pad.description: The gamepad (0 to 3) whose A pressed it this tick; null when the pointer or the keyboard did. Pads 1 to 3 press only while og.ui.setPlayers allows them (local multiplayer).

focusedBy.description: Bit k: pad k's focus is on it (bit 0 is the shared focus of the pointer, the keyboard and pad 0; bits 1 to 3 the other players' pads).

adjust.description: An adjustable element's (ElementDesc.adjustable) Left and Right this tick while it has the focus: +1 for each press of Right, -1 for Left (the screen's directions; a right-to-left screen reads Left as forward); 0 otherwise.

adjustY.description: An element claiming Up and Down (ElementDesc.arrows) this tick while it has the focus: +1 for each press of Down, -1 for Up; 0 otherwise.

ring.description: The focus ring is up on it: the focus is on it and keys or a pad put it there (a press of the pointer, or a focus returned by a closing dialog to a pointer's player, puts it away). With ElementDesc.ownRing the component draws its own ring and what keys show (a cursor's card lifted).

tapped.description: Its tap was recognised this tick (ElementProps.gestures): a press and a release inside it within the slop and, where it declares a double tap, once that double tap's window has passed without a second tap. Keys and pads tap it by activating it.

doubleTapped.description: The second tap of its double tap landed this tick.

longPressed.description: Its long press fired this tick; the press it took clicks and taps nothing when released.

longPress.description: How far into its long press the held press is, 0 to 1 (0: none): a ring that fills while a touch is held.

SliderResult.description: A slider's response and its value after this tick's input.

value.description: The value, to keep in game state and pass back next tick.

ToggleResult.description: A toggle's response and its state after this tick's input.

on.description: The state, to keep in game state and pass back next tick.

FieldResult.description: A text field's response and its text after this tick's input.

value.description: The text, to keep in game state and pass back next tick.

Viewport.description: The play surface the UI lays out in, in og-ui units (CSS px over UiTheme.unit) and device pixels per unit.

dpr.description: Device pixels per CSS pixel; rectangles snap to device pixels.

safeArea.description: The device's unsafe margins (notch, home indicator); the root pads by them.

coarsePointer.description: A touch screen or another coarse pointer.

reducedMotion.description: The page prefers reduced motion (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, from the web shell): the UI's theme only fades, whatever UiDesc.reducedMotion says. Omitted is false.

highContrast.description: The page prefers more contrast (prefers-contrast: more, from the web shell): the UI's theme is the high-contrast one, whatever UiDesc.contrast says. Omitted is false.

reducedTransparency.description: The page prefers less transparency (prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce, from the web shell): glass parts are opaque surfaces and the scrim and translucent fills flat, whatever UiDesc.reducedTransparency says (UiTheme.reducedTransparency). Omitted is false.

macKeys.description: Text controls take macOS's editing keys: Command with A, C, X and Z, Command+←/→ to the line's ends (↑/↓ the text's), Option+←/→ and Option+Backspace by words, Control+A and E to the line's ends. Off: Control takes the shortcuts and moves by words (Alt too), Home and End go to the line's ends. The web shell sets it from the browser's platform (Apple's); a native host sets it on macOS, so a script that holds Ctrl or Meta edits as a person on that OS would (og.ui.previewViewport pins either). Omitted is false.

covered.description: Where the host's own control covers the surface: on a published page the web shell's round Back to the Portal, top left (about 12, 12 to 52, 52 CSS px; its name shows beside it for the first seconds of play). Anchored groups keep out of it, moved along the edge they sit on (a top-left group to its right), so the HUD templates never draw under it; a game drawing its own corner reads it from og.ui.frameViewport. Empty (omitted) is none: native hosts and pages without Back.

breakpoint.description: Its size class: phone portrait or landscape, tablet, desktop.

hud.description: The HUD band (read only): the safe area at most UiDesc.hudMaxAspect times its height wide, centred, where anchored groups and toasts lay out; a component that places itself (a HUD of the game's own) reads it so it sits with them on an ultrawide. Ignored where a host passes a viewport in.

UiDesc.description: How the UI looks: the scheme, the density, its fonts, the contrast, the game's primary colour, motion, transparency, the icon atlas, the style and the sounds. og.ui.configure takes it in part: a field left out keeps the value the last call (or a look's style) gave it, null clears it.

font.description: The body font, from og.load.font; null measures text at half an em per character and draws none.

displayFont.description: The display font; null uses the body font.

monoFont.description: The monospaced font; null uses the body font.

roundedFont.description: The rounded font (levels and scores); null uses the display font, then the body font.

fallbackFonts.description: Fonts for other scripts (Hebrew, Devanagari, a CJK face with `font { runtime true }`), tried in order after the locale's (og.i18n) for a text the role's font cannot draw whole. A text mixing scripts takes each run from the first font that has it (the role's for its Latin, a fallback for its CJK or Arabic), one label in several fonts.

contrast.description: Standard or high contrast. The page's prefers-contrast: more takes high contrast too (Viewport.highContrast).

primaryColor.description: An sRGB colour as the game's primary (its hover, pressed and soft tones derived from it, the ink on it whichever of ink and inkInverse reads better); null keeps the style's.

reducedMotion.description: Transitions only fade; sheens stop. The page's prefers-reduced-motion turns it on too (Viewport.reducedMotion).

textScale.description: The player's text size (a settings screen's slider, kept with the other settings): every text size and leading is multiplied by it and the layout grows around the text (control, row and header heights by the leading body text gains), never clipping it. 1 is the style's sizes, 1.5 the largest (a larger one lays out at 1.5): docs/ui.md §15.2 holds every screen to 1.5, 200 % deferred.

unitScale.description: The og-ui unit in CSS px (docs/ui.md §15.2): the UI lays out in units (og.ui.viewport and og.ui.frameViewport are the surface over it) and draws them at it, so every length grows with the surface (the style's text, space, radii and controls, and a game's own px, alike) and the player's textScale multiplies over it. 0 is auto: on a mouse or pad surface its 1080p-equivalent height (the shorter of the height and the width's 16:9 height) over 720, 1 to 2, so a 1280x720 layout fills a 1080p window with body text at 21 CSS px and the smallest step at 18; a touch surface keeps CSS px (1). A value of 1 to 2 pins it (a game that lays out for one size).

reducedTransparency.description: Nothing is see-through: glass parts (a style's glass line) are opaque surfaces (no blur of the frame under them, their frame whole), the scrim is the opaque colour it makes over backdrop and the translucent fills (control, controlStrong, primarySoft, hud) the opaque colours they make over panel. The page's prefers-reduced-transparency turns it on too (Viewport.reducedTransparency); UiTheme.reducedTransparency says it is on.

icons.description: The icon atlas og.ui.icon draws from; null takes the style's.

fallbackIcons.description: The icon set that draws the names the atlas lacks (icons, or the style's when icons is null): a game's whole set, such as the UI kit's iconoir set, under a style pack's few painted icons, which keep the names they paint. og.ui.icon, rich text's [icon=], an action's glyph and an art slot's placeholder all look in it; a name in neither warns. null is none.

images.description: Pictures rich text draws inline by name ([img=<name>]): a portrait in a line of dialogue, an item's art in a tooltip. Any texture, not only the icon atlas's cells; each one em tall at its aspect, in its own colours.

toastAnchor.description: Where toasts stack; null is the bottom centre.

hudMaxAspect.description: The widest the HUD band is, over its height: on a wider surface (a 21:9 or 32:9 ultrawide monitor) the anchored groups (og.ui.anchor, the HUD corners) and the toasts lay out in a band this wide, centred in the safe area, so the player's eyes stay near the play; og.ui.viewport's hud is that band. 16/9 keeps a 16:9 game's HUD where it was designed; 0 is the whole safe area (a HUD at the screen's edges). Full-screen layers (dialogs, menus, scrims, world-space markers and their edge clamping) keep the whole surface. The UI itself never stretches: it lays out in CSS pixels at every aspect.

style.description: A UI style from og.load.style: its palette, radii, type ramp, fonts, icons, frames, ornaments, motion and sounds replace the default style (fonts, icons and a primary colour given here still win); null is the default style, the design language the engine shares with origin-agent, for prototypes only (og build --publish refuses a game in it).

sounds.description: Sounds for UI events (they win over the style's).

UiSounds.description: Sounds the UI plays through og-audio (the ui bus) on its events; null is silent.

hover.description: The pointer reaches a control, or keyboard or gamepad focus moves to one.

press.description: A control is pressed: by the pointer, Enter, Space or the gamepad's A.

error.description: A refused press or a danger toast.

StylePart.description: An element class a style dresses with a nine-slice frame.

x-og-variants.button: Buttons (with hover, pressed and disabled states).
x-og-variants.hud: HUD elements over the game (counters, timers) and toasts.

TypeStep.description: One step of the type ramp.

size.description: The font size.

cjkLineHeight.description: The leading text with Chinese, Japanese or Korean characters takes.

cjkTrackingEm.description: Tracking of text containing CJK characters, in em.

weight.description: The face weight (100 to 900); zero takes the font role's own face.

uppercase.description: Style-driven locale-sensitive uppercase, applied before measurement without rewriting source text or editable values.

features.description: The OpenType features the step turns on, as tags: smcp (small caps), c2sc (capitals to small caps), tnum (tabular figures), lnum (lining figures), case (case-sensitive forms). A style sets them after a type role's font (`display 42 48 0.02 700 display smcp`); they apply where the role's font is imported with the same `features` line, and a font without one draws its defaults.

ControlSizes.description: The control, row and header heights and the gutter of the density in effect.

UiTheme.description: The style values the UI draws with, read-only.

palette.description: Each ThemeColor, then each colour role the style declares of its own (docs/ui.md §12.2), as `#rrggbb` or `#rrggbbaa` (sRGB as authored).

space.description: The spacing scale by name (xxs, xs, sm, md, lg, xl, xxl, xl3), in CSS pixels.

radius.description: The corner radii by name (small, control, bar, panel), in CSS pixels.

sizes.description: The control sizes of the density in effect.

durationsMs.description: The motion durations by name (instant, fast, base, slow, spring, bounce), in milliseconds.

style.description: The configured style's name; empty for the default style.

styleVersion.description: The configured style file's version: 1 for a version-1 style, whose game keeps the controls and dialogs it shipped with (docs/ui.md §12.1); 2 for a version-2 style and the default style.

contrast.description: The variant in effect: high when the game asked for it or the page prefers more contrast.

reducedMotion.description: Transitions only fade and sheens stop: the game asked for it or the page prefers reduced motion. A game's own animations read it to keep their state changes and drop their movement.

textScale.description: The player's text scale in effect (UiDesc.textScale, 1 to 1.5): typeRamp and sizes already carry it; tokens' typography is the style's as authored, so a game's own text drawn from it multiplies by this.

unit.description: The og-ui unit in effect, in CSS px (UiDesc.unitScale; auto: 1 to 2 by the surface): what every length the UI reads and gives is in, og.ui.bounds and og.ui.viewport too. Only what leaves the UI for the page is CSS px: the probe's dump_ui and og.render's screen sprites; a game drawing its own screen sprites beside the UI multiplies by it.

reducedTransparency.description: Nothing is see-through: the scrim and the translucent fills of `palette` are already the opaque colours they make over panel (the scrim over backdrop) and glass is an opaque surface; the game asked for it or the page prefers reduced transparency. A game's own translucent overlays read it to draw opaque too.

tokens.description: The style's tokens (docs/ui.md §12.2), what a game's own drawing reads to match its UI: `typography` (each role, display title heading body label caption numeric button, at each breakpoint: size, lineHeight, trackingEm, weight, font, features), the `space`, `size`, `radius` and `stroke` scales by step, `elevation` (each level's shadows: dx, dy, blur, spread, color), `shape` (each element class's corner and radius: the shape language), `springs` (ui, enter, exit, emphasis, playful: durationMs, bounce), `staggerMs`, `overshoot`, the `rarity`, `team` and `series` colours, and `feedback` (each UI event's set: how many sounds, the volume and pitch ranges, the haptic's [startMs, ms, low, high] pulses).

RichTextDesc.description: How a rich text paragraph draws: its defaults, which its markup's spans override.

step.description: The type step; null is body.

color.description: The ink; null is ink.

nowrap.description: Keep to one line (breaking only at `\n`).

width.description: Its width; null fits the text.

RichTextResult.description: What a rich text's links did this tick.

response.description: Its links together: hovered while one is, clicked when one was.

link.description: The link clicked this tick: its `[link=…]` id.

Anchor.description: A point of the safe area an anchored group sits at.

x-og-variants.top: The middle of the top edge.
x-og-variants.left: The middle of the left edge.
x-og-variants.right: The middle of the right edge.
x-og-variants.bottom: The middle of the bottom edge.

TransitionKind.description: How a transition moves its content in and out. Under reduced motion every kind only fades.

x-og-variants.scale: Grows from slightly smaller around its centre.
x-og-variants.pop: Springs up from smaller around its centre, overshoots and settles.
x-og-variants.glitch: Tears in: the content draws through the glitch material (slices pushed sideways, colours split) as it fades in or out, over 150 to 180 ms whatever the style's base duration; as deterministic as every frame (from the element's id and the tick-counted UI clock). A style sets its strength (`enter glitch 0.8`).

Tone.description: A status tone of badges, toasts and map markers.

x-og-variants.neutral: Neutral: control fill and muted ink.
x-og-variants.primary: The game's identity: the primary's soft wash and highlight ink.
x-og-variants.inverse: Neutral emphasis: ink fill, inverse ink.

MeterKind.description: What a meter measures, which sets its colour.

x-og-variants.desktop: 1024 CSS px wide or more, the shorter side 600 or more.
x-og-variants.tablet: The shorter side 600 or more, under 1024 wide.
x-og-variants.phoneLandscape: The shorter side under 600, wider than tall.
x-og-variants.phonePortrait: The shorter side under 600, taller than wide.

Contrast.description: The theme variant: high contrast remaps muted inks, fills and lines to the style's stronger ones and outlines every control (no new colour).

x-og-variants.standard: The style's palette as it is.

NavIntent.description: A focus-navigation intent, as the arrow keys, Tab, Enter, Space, Escape and a gamepad's d-pad, stick, A and B give.

x-og-variants.next: The next control in reading order (Tab).
x-og-variants.activate: Press the focused control (Enter, Space, A).
x-og-variants.back: Leave: the topmost dialog or menu closes, else og.ui.back() answers true (Escape, B).

UiRect.description: A rectangle of the play surface.

IconAtlasDesc.description: The icon atlas: a texture of equal cells in a grid, named in reading order, or an icon set cooked like a font (font).

font.description: An icon set from og.load.font (an `.ogt` of `type icons` naming SVGs, such as the UI kit's iconoir set): its icons are distance-field glyphs, crisp at any size and tinted by their ink, named by the set; texture, columns, rows and names are then not used.

texture.description: The atlas texture, from og.load.texture.

names.description: Each cell's name, in reading order: og.ui.icon draws a cell by its name.

UiInlineImage.description: A picture rich text draws inline by name ([img=<name>]).

name.description: The name markup gives it.

texture.description: The texture, from og.load.texture; null leaves the name unregistered.

uv.description: The region drawn, [u0, v0, u1, v1] with v down; null is the whole texture.

aspect.description: Width over height of the region as drawn; 0 is square.

AnchorDesc.description: An anchored group: a layer at a point of the safe area, over the tree (HUD corners, a centred title, a bar of touch controls).

anchor.description: Where it sits.

margin.description: The inset from the safe area's edges, the same on every edge: a margin wide enough to keep a top-left HUD over a centred portrait play field also pushes it that far down (use offsetX for the sideways shift, or a width); null is the density's gutter.

direction.description: Which way it lays out its children.

align.description: Where children sit along the main axis.

radius.description: Corner radius.

width.description: Its width; null fits the content.

height.description: Its height; null fits the content.

over.description: Draw over dialogs and spotlights (a tutorial callout, a dragged item); the default draws under them.

tooltip.description: Draw in the tooltip layer, over every other layer including the toast stack and over groups: a card the player opened (og.ui.tooltipCard).

avoid.description: Step clear of the other anchored groups and the host's control, to the nearest free place on the safe area: a popup placed at a point (a drift score over the car) that must not cover the map or the tower.

frame.description: The style frame its background takes; null is the panel's.

instant.description: Shown settled the first time it is built: no style entrance or stagger, its controls answering at once. For the screen a game opens on while it is that: the web draws it behind the play gate, where an entrance would stay part-way until the tap.

TransitionDesc.description: How a transition moves, timed in ticks from the style's motion.

durationMs.description: How long entering and leaving take; 0 is motion.duration.base (240 ms).

distance.description: How far slides travel; 0 is space.xl.

instant.description: Shown at once the first time it is built (no entrance).

Presence.description: Where a transition or dialog is this tick.

visible.description: Build its content: shown, entering or leaving.

ModalDesc.description: A dialog: a scrim over everything and a centred panel. Focus moves in and stays while it is the topmost; Back and the backdrop dismiss it unless locked.

title.description: A title over the content, set in the style's heading type role (its step and face); empty is none.

width.description: The panel's width; null is 420 CSS px, at most the surface less its gutters.

locked.description: Back and the backdrop do not dismiss it (a choice must be made).

ignoreBackdrop.description: A press on the backdrop does not dismiss it.

transition.description: How it enters and leaves; null is scale.

backdrop.description: The backdrop's fill; null is scrim.

bare.description: No panel: the content sits centred on the backdrop (full-screen menus, loading).

dismissed.description: Back or a press on the backdrop asked to close it: set your open flag false.

SpotlightDesc.description: A spotlight: the surface dimmed except a hole around a target.

padding.description: Room around the target; 0 is space.sm.

ListDesc.description: A virtualised list: only the rows in view (and one more each side) are built, fillers keep the scroll range of every row.

rowHeight.description: Every row's height; 0 is the density's row height.

height.description: Its height (it scrolls inside); null grows.

selected.description: The selected row (controlStrong), for og.ui.list.

ListRange.description: The rows (or cells) to build this tick: first up to, not including, last.

ListResult.description: What happened in a list or grid this tick.

clicked.description: The row or cell pressed (or activated) this tick.

dropFrom.description: A drag and drop ended: the index it started on.

dropTo.description: And the index it was released over.

GridDesc.description: A virtualised grid of equal cells (inventories, level select), scrolling vertically.

cellWidth.description: A cell's width; 0 is 64 (never under the 44 px touch target). With columns set and a width other than fit, the cells share the grid's width instead, as wide as it allows (never under the touch target), and keep their height.

cellHeight.description: A cell's height; 0 is its width.

columns.description: Cells across, exactly, whatever the width: a fit grid is that many cells of cellWidth, any other the cells share; 0 is as many cells of cellWidth as fit.

width.description: Its width; null fits (exactly the columns when columns is set).

selected.description: The selected cell, for og.ui.grid.

width.description: Its width; null fits (grows with fill).

label.description: What a screen reader calls the row of tabs (its accessible name), never drawn; empty is its id. A localised game passes its string table's.

ChoiceResult.description: A choice control's response and the chosen index after this tick's input.

response.description: What happened to it; changed when the choice moved.

selected.description: The chosen index, to keep in game state and pass back next tick.

SelectDesc.description: A select: a trigger that opens a menu of options.

label.description: What a screen reader calls it (its accessible name; the chosen option is its value), never drawn; empty is its id. A localised game passes its string table's.

StepperDesc.description: A number stepper's range, step and digits.

min.description: The smallest value; min equal to max (the zero value) is unbounded.

step.description: How much a press changes it; 0 is 1.

StepperResult.description: A stepper's response and value after this tick's input.

value.description: The value, to keep in game state and pass back next tick.

RadioDesc.description: How a radio group lays out, and its name.

horizontal.description: Options in a row (the default is a column).

label.description: What a screen reader calls the group (its accessible name), never drawn; empty is its id. A localised game passes its string table's.

CheckListResult.description: A checkbox list's response and values after this tick's input.

response.description: What happened to it; changed when any box flipped.

values.description: The values, to keep in game state and pass back next tick.

tone.description: Its tone: a dot of the tone's colour before the text.

durationMs.description: How long it stays; 0 is 3200 ms (6000 for danger).

selected.description: Selected: inverted to ink.

MeterDesc.description: A meter: a track with a fill that animates its changes by the tick.

kind.description: What it measures, which sets its colour.

color.description: A colour of your own instead of the kind's.

label.description: Text inside the bar (such as `75 / 100`); empty is none.

height.description: Its height; 0 is space.md, or the caption's line with a label.

segments.description: Notches dividing it into this many parts; 0 or 1 is none.

CooldownDesc.description: A cooldown ring's size and centre.

size.description: Its diameter; 0 is 56 (never under 44).

label.description: Text in the middle (a key, seconds left); empty is none.

icon.description: An icon of the atlas in the middle, by name; empty is none.

IconDesc.description: An icon's size, ink and name.

size.description: Its size; 0 is 24.

secondary.description: A second atlas icon, overlaid in the same em square: author the two silhouettes as separate named layers. Null draws one layer.

secondaryTint.description: The second layer's ink; null is accent.

label.description: What a screen reader calls it (and the probe's text): null is the icon's name in the atlas (an English word: `star`); empty is decoration, named by nothing, so a card or button it sits on is named by its other text. A localised game names a meaningful icon from its string table.

tone.description: Its colour; neutral is the stage ink.

player.description: The player: the primary, larger, ringed.

texture.description: The map; null is the stage colour.

uv.description: The region of the map shown, [u0, v0, u1, v1]; null is the whole texture.

size.description: Its side; 0 is 160.

label.description: A zone name under it; empty is none.

DialogueDesc.description: A dialogue box: a portrait slot, the speaker and the line typed out by the tick.

text.description: The line. A new text starts typing again.

portrait.description: A portrait texture; null is the speaker's initial.

portraitUv.description: The portrait's region of the texture; null is the whole texture.

portraitIcon.description: A portrait from the icon atlas by name, when no texture is given; empty is the speaker's initial.

DialogueResult.description: A dialogue box's answer this tick.

advanced.description: Pressed (or activated) while done: show the next line.

JoystickDesc.description: A virtual joystick: one translucent disc of the HUD ground with a rim (part Joystick.base, which a style dresses) and a knob that follows the finger that started on it, the rim lit toward the push while held. A finger sliding onto it from elsewhere does not take it.

size.description: The base's diameter; 0 is 128 (never under three touch targets).

deadZone.description: The ignored radius; 0 is 0.15. Past it the vector is rescaled, rising from 0 at the dead zone's edge to 1 at the base's.

customize.description: The player can move, scale and fade it in the HUD edit mode (og.ui.setHudEdit).

disabled.description: It answers nothing and shows faded (a cutscene, a stun).

x.description: -1 left to 1 right; 0 inside the dead zone.

y.description: -1 up to 1 down; 0 inside the dead zone.

active.description: A press that started on it is held.

DpadDesc.description: A d-pad: one round pad (part Dpad.base, which a style dresses) with four chevrons on it, read as one target by the angle of the finger from its centre: eight ways (a diagonal holds both of its arms), nothing in its middle, the held direction lit under its chevron. The thumb rolls between directions without lifting.

size.description: The pad's size; 0 is 132 (each arm at least 44).

customize.description: The player can move, scale and fade it in the HUD edit mode (og.ui.setHudEdit).

disabled.description: It answers nothing and shows faded.

DpadResult.description: Which arms of a d-pad are held this tick.

ActionButtonDesc.description: A touch action button (jump, fire, a skill): a disc with a rim (part ActionButton.face, flagged primary, pressed and disabled, which a style dresses), its icon on it; a label wider than it with no icon widens it to a capsule instead. A further touch holds it only when it went down on it, so a thumb steering a stick never fires it by sliding over.

size.description: Its side; 0 is 64 (never under 44).

icon.description: An icon of the atlas by name, instead of the label; empty is the label.

customize.description: The player can move, scale and fade it in the HUD edit mode (og.ui.setHudEdit).

round.description: Kept a disc when its label is wider than it (it grows as a disc, a pedal) instead of widening to a capsule; a button with an icon, a short label or a charge is a disc anyway.

charge.description: A ring inside its edge, lit clockwise from the top to this (0 to 1: a boost's charge, a brake's pressure), with a faint track for the rest. It follows the pad's outline, so a pad with a charge is drawn round. null draws no ring.

chargeTone.description: The lit ring's tone; neutral is the primary's.

disabled.description: It answers nothing and shows faded (out of ammunition, not yet learnt).

SkeletonDesc.description: A skeleton: the neutral fill standing in for content that is loading.

height.description: A line's height; 0 is the body size.

lines.description: Stacked lines; 0 or 1 is one, the last of several is shorter.

UiPointer.description: The primary pointer as the UI reads it this tick.

x.description: Its x from the surface's left.

y.description: Its y from the surface's top.

inside.description: It is over the surface: false for a mouse that left it, or a touch screen with no finger down.

down.description: Its button or finger is down.

pressed.description: Its button or finger went down this tick: where a drag a component runs itself (an inventory's item, a card) starts.

released.description: Its button or finger came up this tick: where such a drag ends.

shift.description: A Shift key is held (a split stack, a quick transfer, a range of a list).

ScrollState.description: A scroll container as the last frame laid it out (og.ui.scrollState).

offsetX.description: How far its content is scrolled right.

offsetY.description: How far its content is scrolled down.

viewWidth.description: Its view's width, inside its padding.

viewHeight.description: Its view's height, inside its padding.

contentWidth.description: Its whole content's width, unclipped (the view's on an axis it does not scroll).

VirtualCursorDesc.description: A pad's virtual cursor (docs/ui.md §8.3). The zero value moves at 900 units a second, takes a quarter second from a fine start to full speed, has a half-strength magnet and scrolls 1200 units a second.

speed.description: Units a second at full tilt; 0 is 900.

accel.description: Milliseconds a held stick takes from a third of its speed to all of it, for fine aim first; 0 is 250, negative is none.

magnet.description: 0 to 1: how much it slows over a control and, once the stick rests, pulls to the control's centre; 0 is 0.5, negative is none.

scroll.description: Units a second the right stick scrolls under it at full tilt; 0 is 1200, negative leaves the right stick to the game.

VirtualCursor.description: Where a pad's virtual cursor is.

x.description: Its x, from the surface's left.

y.description: Its y, from the surface's top.

shown.description: It is shown: the stick moved it since the real pointer last moved.

HudPlacement.description: Where the player put a customisable element: moved from its laid-out place, scaled about its centre and faded.

HudEdit.description: The HUD edit mode as the last frame left it.

player.description: The player whose layout the screen shows and edits.

selected.description: The key of the element being edited; empty for none.

keys.description: The customisable elements on screen, in drawing order.

changed.description: The player changed the layout this tick (a move ended, a step, a reset): the time to save og.ui.hudLayout in the game's settings.

HudEditorDesc.description: The HUD edit mode's panel; empty labels take English ones (pass the locale's).

title.description: Its title; empty is Edit HUD.

sizeLabel.description: The size steps' label; empty is Size.

opacityLabel.description: The opacity steps' label; empty is Opacity.

HudEditorResult.description: What the HUD editor's buttons did this tick.

done.description: Done was pressed: the edit mode is off from the next tick.

changed.description: A step or a reset changed the layout this tick.

A11yNode.description: One node of the accessibility tree: an element with a role (layout containers and spacers have none and are left out).

path.description: Its path, as touch_move_to and og.ui.focus name it.

parent.description: The path of the nearest node above it in the tree; empty at the top.

role.description: Its role (probe.UiElement.role): button, link, text, heading, image, checkbox, radio, switch, slider, spinbutton, textbox, combobox, listbox, option, tab, tablist, radiogroup, progressbar, meter, timer, status, dialog, tooltip, separator, group.

name.description: Its accessible name: what a screen reader says it is. A text field or area is named by the label before it in its row, else by its placeholder, else by its id; never by the text in it (that is its value).

description.description: Read after the name (aria-description): a text field's placeholder when a label names it; empty for none.

value.description: Its value as text (a slider's number, a progress's percent, a field's text); empty for none.

states.description: Its states: disabled, focused, focusable, checked, selected, expanded, collapsed (expandable and closed), pressed, busy, offscreen (a scroll container cuts it out of view).

valueMin.description: A range's smallest value (aria-valuemin): a slider's min, a bounded stepper's, 0 for a progress (in percent) and a meter; null for a stepper without bounds and a control that is no range.

valueMax.description: A range's largest value (aria-valuemax): a slider's max, a bounded stepper's, 100 for a progress, a meter's max; null as valueMin is.

valueNow.description: A range's value as a number (aria-valuenow; value says it as people read it): a slider's, a stepper's, a meter's, a progress's percent; null for a control that is no range.

x.description: Left edge of the whole element.

y.description: Top edge of the whole element.

A11yTree.description: The last frame's accessibility tree, built from the same nodes the UI draws and takes input on.

nodes.description: The nodes, in tree order: the page, then each layer over it (a dialog after the page).

focusOrder.description: The paths keyboard Tab and the pads visit, in order: the nodes marked focusable, within the topmost dialog while one is open.

focused.description: The path keyboard and pad 0's focus is on; empty for none.

CounterDesc.description: A number that counts to its value.

step.description: The type step; null is body.

font.description: Which font: mono (the numeric role) for counts in a row, display for a big score.

color.description: The ink; null is ink.

align.description: How it aligns in its width.

width.description: Its width; null fits the text.

durationMs.description: How long a change takes to count; 0 is 900 ms.

from.description: Where the first count starts; null starts at the value (no count).

BurstDesc.description: Rays and sparks thrown from an element.

color.description: Their ink; null is the primary.

radius.description: How far they fly from the element's centre; 0 is 1.4 times its size.

durationMs.description: How long they fly; 0 is motion.duration.slow plus base.

delayMs.description: Wait this long after the element first appears.

ShakeDesc.description: A shake of an element: three sideways swings decaying to rest.

amount.description: The first swing; 0 is the style's motion.shake, else 6.

durationMs.description: How long it takes to come to rest; 0 is motion.duration.slow.

sound.description: Also play the style's error sound, as a refused press does.

ScreenWipe.description: How a screen transition covers the old screen and reveals the new one.

x-og-variants.fade: The cover fades in and out.
x-og-variants.iris: A circle closes on the centre and opens again.
x-og-variants.dissolve: Cells appear in a fixed scattered order.
x-og-variants.slide: A sheet slides over and away.

WipeSide.description: Where a wipe or a slide comes from.

durationMs.description: Cover and reveal together; 0 is twice motion.duration.slow.

color.description: The cover's colour (the texture's tint); null is backdrop.

texture.description: A texture stretched over the surface as the cover; null is the flat colour.

from.description: Where a wipe or a slide comes from.

ScreenTransitionResult.description: Where a screen transition is this tick.

shown.description: The screen to build this tick: the old one until the cover closes, then the new one.

covering.description: The cover is closing over the old screen.

revealing.description: The cover is opening on the new screen.

cover.description: How much of the surface is covered, 0 to 1.

CardVariant.description: How a card stands off what it sits on.

x-og-variants.raised: A raised panel with the card class's elevation (the default).
x-og-variants.outlined: A panel with an outline and no shadow.
x-og-variants.inset: A well sunk into the surface.

CardMedia.description: A card's media slot: art the game fills, or a placeholder drawn from the style when it has none.

texture.description: The art (og.load.texture), covering the slot; 0 draws the placeholder.

focal.description: The art's point kept in view when cover crops it, fractions of the free space.

icon.description: The placeholder's icon (og.ui.icon's name); empty is `image`.

label.description: What the art shows, for a screen reader; empty is decorative.

CardDesc.description: A card: media, an eyebrow, a title, a subtitle and a corner badge over a body the game builds.

variant.description: How it stands off what it sits on.

media.description: The media slot over the body; null is none.

eyebrow.description: A small line over the title (a category, a rarity); empty is none.

title.description: The title; empty is none.

subtitle.description: A line under the title; empty is none.

badge.description: A badge in the top end corner; empty is none.

number.description: A number on a small plate at the top start corner (its place in a hand, its slot), over the media's corner when there is media, else above the body; small, so the art stays the card's one dominant element. Empty is none.

cost.description: A numeral in a disc (a cost, a level): with media on the art's bottom end corner, opposite the number plate, so the body's text keeps the card's whole width; with none at the body's bottom end, beside it, so the game's text never runs under it. Small, so the art stays the card's one dominant element. Empty is none.

interactive.description: The whole card is a button: it lifts under the pointer and the focus, sinks when pressed, and answers clicked.

selected.description: Ringed in the focus ink (Card.frame[selected]).

padding.description: Space around the body; null is space.lg.

ScrollAreaDesc.description: A scroll area: og.ui's scroll container whose content fades out at an edge where more lies beyond.

height.description: Its height (it scrolls inside); null fits the content.

gap.description: Space between children; null is space.sm.

fade.description: How far the edge fades reach; 0 is 24.

fadeInto.description: The surface the content fades into; null is panel.

label.description: What a screen reader calls the region.

AccordionSection.description: A section of an accordion: its header's title, subtitle and badge.

title.description: The header's title.

subtitle.description: A line under it; empty is none.

badge.description: A badge at the header's end; empty is none.

disabled.description: The header is shown but does not open.

AccordionDesc.description: An accordion: sections whose headers open and close their bodies.

AccordionResult.description: What an accordion answered this tick.

toggled.description: The section whose header was pressed.

expanded.description: The open sections after this tick: keep them and pass them back.

SplitViewDesc.description: Two panes with a divider between them that a drag moves.

direction.description: Side by side (row) or one over the other (column).

ratio.description: The start pane's share of the room (keep SplitResult.ratio).

minStart.description: The start pane's least size; 0 is 120.

minEnd.description: The end pane's least size; 0 is 120.

snaps.description: The ratios a press of the focused divider steps through; empty is a third, a half, two thirds.

keepOnPhone.description: Stay side by side on a phone in portrait (it stacks by default).

label.description: What a screen reader calls the divider.

SplitResult.description: What a split view answered this tick.

ratio.description: The start pane's share after this tick: keep it and pass it back.

changed.description: The divider was moved or stepped this tick.

stacked.description: It is stacked (a phone in portrait).

DialogTone.description: A dialog's tone, shown by a mark as well as its colour.

id.description: The id answered when it is pressed; also its probe id.

label.description: What it says; empty is its id.

variant.description: Its weight: the primary sits last in a row and first in a phone's stack.

autofocus.description: It takes the focus when the dialog opens.

DialogDesc.description: A dialog: a title, a tone mark, a message, a body the game builds and a row of actions.

title.description: Its title.

message.description: The message, as rich text markup (og.ui.richText).

actions.description: The buttons; ordered by weight on each breakpoint.

cancelId.description: The action that cancels (its sound is cancel's); empty is `cancel`.

locked.description: Back and the backdrop do not dismiss it.

width.description: Its width; null is 460 (wide 640), at most the surface less its gutters.

transition.description: How it enters and leaves; null is the style's.

DialogResult.description: What a dialog answered this tick.

action.description: The id of the action pressed.

dismissed.description: Back or the backdrop asked to close it.

visible.description: It is on screen (open, or leaving).

ConfirmResult.description: A confirm dialog's answer this tick.

ConfirmationDesc.description: A confirmation: a message, Cancel and the action.

title.description: Its title.

message.description: What will happen, as rich text markup.

confirmLabel.description: The action's label; empty is Confirm.

danger.description: The action cannot be undone: the danger variant, and Cancel takes the focus.

tone.description: Its tone when it is not danger.

locked.description: Back and the backdrop do not cancel.

FloatSide.description: Where a floating surface hangs off what it belongs to; start and end follow the writing direction.

FloatAlign.description: How a floating surface lines up with what it belongs to.

PopoverDesc.description: A popover beside an element, flipped where there is no room and kept on screen, with an arrow at the element.

anchor.description: The path of the element it belongs to (og.ui.lastPath right after building it); empty centres it.

align.description: How it lines up with the element.

arrow.description: Draw an arrow at the element.

title.description: A title over the content; empty is none.

width.description: Its width; null fits, at most 360.

PopoverResult.description: What a popover answered this tick.

dismissed.description: Back or a press outside asked to close it.

visible.description: It is on screen (open, or leaving).

x-og-variants.check: A command with a check mark (menuitemcheckbox).

MenuEntry.description: An entry of a menu. An entry whose `parent` names another's id sits in that entry's submenu.

id.description: The id answered when it is chosen; also its probe id.

label.description: What it says.

icon.description: An icon before the label; empty is none.

shortcut.description: A shortcut shown at the end (`Ctrl+S`).

checked.description: A check or radio entry is on.

danger.description: A destructive command: the danger ink.

parent.description: The id of the entry whose submenu it is in; empty is the top level.

MenuDesc.description: A menu hanging from an element, or at a point (a context menu).

anchor.description: The path of the element it hangs from.

at.description: A point it opens at instead (CSS px): where a right press or a long press happened.

side.description: The side of the element it prefers.

align.description: How it lines up with the element.

maxWidth.description: Its greatest width; 0 is 360 at 100 % text, growing with the player's text size. Never past the screen: past it a label wraps.

label.description: What a screen reader calls it.

MenuChoice.description: What a menu answered this tick.

chosen.description: The id of the entry chosen: close it.

dismissed.description: It asked to close (a choice, Back, a press outside).

SheetEdge.description: The edge a sheet slides in from; start and end follow the writing direction.

SheetDesc.description: A sheet: a surface that slides in from an edge over a scrim; a bottom sheet rests at detents and a drag moves it.

detents.description: A bottom sheet's rest heights, fractions of the room; empty is 0.5 and 0.92.

detent.description: The detent it rests at (keep SheetResult.detent).

size.description: A side sheet's width; 0 is 400.

title.description: A title at its top; empty is none.

dismissible.description: A drag past the lowest detent, a swipe outwards, Back or the scrim close it.

closeButton.description: A close button by the title; null is a side sheet's only.

closeLabel.description: The close button's accessible name; empty is Close.

SheetResult.description: What a sheet answered this tick.

detent.description: The detent it rests at after this tick: keep it.

dismissed.description: It asked to close: set open false.

visible.description: It is on screen (open, or leaving).

TabVariant.description: How the selected tab is marked.

x-og-variants.underline: An underline that slides between tabs (the default).
x-og-variants.pill: A pill behind the tab, on a track.

label.description: What it says.

icon.description: An icon before it; empty is none.

badge.description: A count badge after it; empty is none.

TabBarDesc.description: Tabs over the panel the game builds for the selected one.

selected.description: The selected tab (keep TabBarResult.selected).

variant.description: How the selected tab is marked.

bumpers.description: The tabPrev and tabNext actions (Q and E, LB and RB) step through the tabs, their glyphs on the device used last (keyboard, Xbox, PlayStation, Switch) at the row's ends.

wrap.description: Stepping past the last tab comes back to the first.

fill.description: The tabs share the row's width.

gap.description: Space between the row and the panel; null is space.md.

label.description: What a screen reader calls the tab list.

TabBarResult.description: What a tab bar answered this tick.

selected.description: The selected tab after this tick: keep it.

CarouselDesc.description: Pages side by side that a drag or a flick moves, snapping to a page.

peek.description: How much of the pages beside the current one shows; null is 24 on a phone, else 0.

gap.description: Space between pages; null is space.md.

arrows.description: Previous and next buttons; null is all but a phone.

autoplayMs.description: Move on by itself after this long untouched; 0 never (and never under reduced motion).

label.description: What a screen reader calls it.

CarouselResult.description: What a carousel answered this tick.

index.description: The current page after this tick: keep it.

Crumb.description: A step of a breadcrumb path.

label.description: What it says.

icon.description: An icon before it; empty is none.

BreadcrumbsDesc.description: The path to where the player is; every crumb but the last is a link back.

items.description: The crumbs, the current page last.

maxShown.description: The most crumbs shown before the middle collapses into a menu; null is 3 on a phone, else 5.

moreLabel.description: The collapsed crumbs' button's accessible name; empty is Show path.

label.description: What a screen reader calls it; empty is Breadcrumb.

chosen.description: The crumb pressed (go back to it).

PaginationDesc.description: Previous and next, the first and last pages and the pages around the current one.

siblings.description: Pages shown each side of the current one; null is 1.

compact.description: Only `4 / 20` between the arrows; null is a phone's.

bumpers.description: The tabPrev and tabNext actions page.

prevLabel.description: Previous's accessible name; empty is Previous page.

nextLabel.description: Next's accessible name; empty is Next page.

label.description: What a screen reader calls it; empty is Pagination.

page.description: The current page after this tick: keep it.

ActionHint.description: A hint of the action bar: an action, its glyph on the device in use and what it does.

action.description: The action's name (answered when the hint is pressed).

icon.description: The glyph's icon, for an action with no glyph on the device in use (a UI action's own glyph, og.ui.frameGlyph, follows the device live and wins).

text.description: The glyph as text (`Enter`, `A`, `LB`), with the same fallback as icon.

hold.description: It fires on a hold: a ring fills.

progress.description: How far the hold has gone.

ActionHintsDesc.description: The action bar (docs/ui.md §8.2): the actions the top layer accepts, each its glyph and its hint, at an edge.

hints.description: The hints, as og.ui.actionBar answers them.

anchor.description: The edge it sits on.

label.description: What a screen reader calls it; empty is Actions.

ActionHintsResult.description: What the action bar answered this tick.

pressed.description: The action of the hint pressed (a touch, a click): act as if the control fired.

height.description: The room it takes from its edge of the screen, the safe area under it included (as laid out last tick): a scrolling screen pads its content's end by it, so nothing hides under the bar. Under a finger it is a bar of buttons across the bottom.

RadialItem.description: A slice of a radial wheel.

label.description: What it is.

icon.description: Its icon; empty is none.

detail.description: A line the centre shows while it is chosen.

cost.description: A price under its label, a coin before it (a build wheel's 150); empty is none.

unaffordable.description: Its cost cannot be paid now: the cost in the danger hue. It stays choosable (the game refuses it and says why) unless disabled.

RadialDesc.description: A radial wheel: slices around a centre, chosen by where the pointer or a stick points.

items.description: The slices, clockwise from the top.

aim.description: A stick's direction (x right, y down, -1 to 1); null reads the pointer.

deadZone.description: How far the stick must point before a slice is chosen.

release.description: The press or stick that opened it was let go: pick the slice it points at.

radius.description: Its radius; null is up to 170, at most 36 % of the short side.

hole.description: The centre's radius as a fraction of the wheel's.

title.description: What the centre shows when nothing is chosen.

labels.description: Each slice's label under its icon.

RadialResult.description: What a radial wheel answered this tick.

chosen.description: The slice picked (a release, a press).

dismissed.description: Back or a press outside asked to close it.

DataStateDesc.description: What a data view shows instead of its rows: loading, an error, or nothing.

error.description: An error to show with Retry; empty is none.

emptyLabel.description: What it says when there is nothing; empty is Nothing here yet.

emptyHint.description: A line under it (what to do).

retry.description: The error has a Retry button.

loadingLabel.description: What a screen reader hears while loading; empty is Loading.

DataListDesc.description: A virtualised list with its empty, loading and error states.

rowHeight.description: Every row's height; null is the density's row height, at least 48.

selected.description: The selected row.

height.description: Its height (it scrolls inside); null fits.

label.description: What a screen reader calls it.

error.description: An error to show with Retry; empty is none.

emptyLabel.description: What it says when there are no rows.

ColorPickerResult.description: A colour picker's colour after this tick.

color.description: The colour, to keep and pass back.

committed.description: A drag ended, a swatch was chosen, a hex was entered or a step landed.

KeyBindingRowDesc.description: A controls screen's row for one action: its name, its bindings on a device, and their capture.

label.description: What it shows; empty is the action's label.

device.description: Whose bindings it shows and captures: keyboard and mouse, or a pad (its family's glyphs); null is the device used last (it follows live).

slots.description: How many bindings it shows on that device (primary, secondary).

reset.description: A reset button while the player changed it.

timeoutMs.description: A capture cancels itself after this long (0: never).

waitingLabel.description: What a slot says while it waits; empty is `Press a key…` (`Press a button…` on a pad).

cancelHint.description: The hint beside it; empty is `Esc to cancel` (the pad's back glyph on a pad).

emptyLabel.description: What an unbound slot says; empty is `—`.

conflictLabel.description: The conflict line, `{control}` and `{action}` filled; empty is `{control} is used by {action}`.

resetLabel.description: The reset button's name; empty is `Reset to default`.

KeyBindingResult.description: What a key-binding row did this tick.

capturing.description: One of its slots waits for input.

changed.description: Its bindings changed this tick (save with og.input.saveBindings).

conflict.description: A captured control is used by another action: the row asks the player.

slot.description: The slot capturing or in conflict (-1: none).

x-og-variants.letters: Latin letters (QWERTY), shift and caps, digits on a long press of the top row (the default).
x-og-variants.numeric: A number pad: digits, a decimal point and a minus.
x-og-variants.kana: The Japanese kana table (gojūon) with the voicing marks, small kana and the long-vowel mark; typed kana compose until committed.

KeyboardDesc.description: An on-screen keyboard: what it edits and how it types.

value.description: The text it edits, from game state.

layout.description: The keys it opens with (the player switches between letters and symbols, and kana when allowed).

compose.description: Letters compose (an IME: pinyin, romaji) instead of typing: the composition shows underlined and candidates take it.

candidates.description: Conversions of the composition the game offers (a dictionary's, for KeyboardResult.composition); the kana layout adds its katakana itself.

title.description: What is being typed (`Name your hero`); empty for none.

placeholder.description: Shown while the text is empty.

submitLabel.description: The enter key's label; empty is `Done`.

password.description: Show the text as dots (the game keeps it); a numeric layout then takes digits only (a PIN: no sign, point or caret keys).

KeyboardResult.description: What an on-screen keyboard did this tick.

value.description: The text, to keep and pass back.

composition.description: What is being composed and not yet committed (show it, and look up candidates for it).

submitted.description: Done was pressed: take the text.

closed.description: It was closed without submitting (Back, the close key, a press outside).

HandCard.description: A card in the player's hand, as the game's viewmodel holds it.

key.description: Its key, stable while it is in the hand: its element id, so its probe path is <id>/Fan/<key>.

name.description: Its name, on its banner.

cost.description: What it costs to play, in its gem in the top start corner; null draws no gem (a free card, a land).

costUp.description: The cost is raised this turn: the gem's number in danger ink.

costDown.description: The cost is lowered: the number in success ink.

typeLine.description: Its type (Attack, Skill · Fire): a line under the art.

text.description: Its rules as rich-text markup (og.ui.richText): [b]Deal 6[/b] damage. [icon=…] and [color=…] are honoured.

image.description: Its art (art kind card); without it a placeholder in its tier's colour.

rarity.description: Its tier: its frame's colour and pips.

playable.description: The player can play it now (enough energy, a legal moment): unplayable cards are dimmed, their cost in danger ink, and a drag of one shakes and is refused.

needsTarget.description: Playing it asks for a target: dragged up, it stays over the hand and an arc follows the pointer to the target under it.

glow.description: It is worth playing now (a combo, a synergy): its edge glows in the primary ink.

fresh.description: Drawn this tick: it flies in from the draw pile.

CardTarget.description: A place a targeted card can be played on: an enemy, an ally, a lane, as the game projects it onto the screen.

key.description: Its key, answered with the play.

name.description: What a screen reader calls it.

rect.description: Where it is on the screen (og.ui.worldAnchor's or a HUD element's rectangle).

valid.description: The aimed card can be played on it: the arc ends in success ink and a ring marks it; an invalid one turns the arc danger.

CardHandDesc.description: A hand of cards, its targets and what it says.

cards.description: The cards, first to last (start to end of the fan).

targets.description: Where a targeted card can go: aiming snaps the arc to the one under the pointer, and keys and pads step through the valid ones.

cardWidth.description: A card's width at rest; 0 is 150 on a desktop (scaled with the screen) and 104 on a phone. Its height is 1.4 times it.

spread.description: How far the fan turns its outermost cards, in degrees; 0 is 3 a card, at most 18.

playLine.description: How far up the screen a card must be dragged to play, as a fraction of the screen's height from its bottom; 0 is 0.36.

disabled.description: Not the player's turn: cards lift and can be read, none plays.

inspect.description: The key of a card shown large in the middle (the details action, a long press); empty shows none.

label.description: What a screen reader calls the hand.

targetPrompt.description: What the arc's tip says while aiming with keys and pads.

CardPlay.description: A card played: the game spends its cost and resolves it.

key.description: The card.

target.description: The target's key, for a card that needs one.

CardAim.description: A targeted card being aimed: what to preview (the damage on the enemy under it).

key.description: The card.

target.description: The valid or invalid target under the arc's tip; null over none.

CardHandResult.description: What the hand did this tick.

played.description: A card played: a non-targeted one released above the play line (or confirmed with keys), a targeted one released on a valid target (or confirmed on one).

hovered.description: The card under the pointer or the focus.

inspect.description: A card whose details were asked for: a long press, the details action; set CardHandDesc.inspect to it, and clear it on dismissed.

dismissed.description: The large card was dismissed (Back, a press).

refused.description: An unplayable card the player tried to play: it shook, and the game may say why.

x-og-variants.primary: The style's primary, lit from the top (End turn, Done, Play).
x-og-variants.premium: Gold: the purchase a screen leads with (Summon ×10).
x-og-variants.secondary: A raised neutral beside a primary or premium one (Summon ×1).
x-og-variants.danger: A destructive action, raised in the danger colour.

HeroButtonDesc.description: A call to action: tone, height, a keycap and whether it can be pressed now.

size.description: Its height: the control heights of the density, at least 44 CSS px on touch.

disabled.description: Not now (the enemy's turn): it lies flat and inert, its label in the faint ink.

width.description: Its width; null fits the label.

key.description: The key or pad glyph of its action, in a keycap after the label (E, Space); empty shows none.

RewardTagKind.description: What a reward's corner tag says.

x-og-variants.new: Never taken before: the tier's own ink, as a pull's New.
x-og-variants.upgrade: It improves one the player holds: the success ink with an up arrow.

RewardOption.description: One reward of a choice, as the game's viewmodel holds it.

key.description: Its key, stable while offered: its element id, so its probe path is <id>/Options/<key>.

title.description: What it is (Thunder Strike, +20 % Max Health).

kind.description: Its kind or source over the title (Relic, Gift of the Storm Warden, Weapon).

text.description: What it does, as rich-text markup (og.ui.richText): [b], [color=…] and [icon=…] are honoured.

image.description: Its art (art kind item or card); without it a placeholder in its tier's colour.

icon.description: An icon of the style's set for the placeholder.

rarity.description: Its tier: the frame's colour, a glow from epic, and its pips.

tag.description: A short tag in its corner (New, Upgrade, Lv 3 → 4); empty draws none.

tagKind.description: What the tag says, which sets its ink: new in the tier's colour, upgrade in success ink with an up arrow.

locked.description: It cannot be taken (a requirement unmet): shaded with a lock, and a press shakes.

lockedHint.description: Why, said under its text and to a screen reader.

RewardChoiceDesc.description: A choice of rewards and what it allows.

title.description: The heading over them (Choose a reward); empty is none.

picks.description: How many to take: 1 takes the one pressed at once (or after confirm with confirm); more need confirm.

confirm.description: A press selects; a Confirm button takes the selection (a choice the player should not take by a slip).

selected.description: The keys selected, for picks over one or confirm: the game passes back what it was answered.

rerolls.description: Rerolls left: a Reroll button with the count; 0 shows it spent; -1 shows none.

rerollCost.description: What a reroll costs, beside its label (50 gold); empty is free.

banishes.description: Banishes left: a Banish button that arms banishing, after which a press on a reward banishes it; -1 shows none.

skipLabel.description: A Skip button's label (Skip, Take 25 gold); empty shows none.

cardWidth.description: A reward's width; 0 is 260 on a desktop (scaled with the screen) and the phone's room. Its height follows its content.

RewardChoiceResult.description: What the choice did this tick.

picked.description: The rewards taken: one pressed (picks 1, no confirm), or the selection confirmed. Empty while none.

selected.description: The selection after this tick's press (pass it back as RewardChoiceDesc.selected).

rerolled.description: Reroll was pressed: offer new rewards and one fewer reroll.

banished.description: A reward banished: remove it and one banish.

hovered.description: The reward under the pointer or the focus.

refused.description: A locked reward pressed: it shook.

StarBarDesc.description: A level's score toward its stars.

max.description: The score that fills the bar; 0 is the last threshold.

thresholds.description: The scores for each star, low to high; empty is a third, two thirds and all of max.

label.description: The caption over the score (Score); empty is none.

valueText.description: The score as written (18,450); empty writes value grouped.

compact.description: One line: the score beside the bar (a phone's top strip).

starsLabel.description: Its stars to a screen reader ({n} earned of {max}).

StarBarResult.description: What the bar showed this tick.

crossed.description: Stars earned this tick (a threshold crossed): play the game's own fanfare if it has one.

IdleGeneratorDesc.description: A generator of an idle game, as the game's viewmodel holds it. The game writes its numbers (og.ui.formatNumber, idle letters), so they read in its notation and language.

name.description: What it is (Solar Array).

image.description: Its art (art kind item); null draws icon or a bolt.

icon.description: An icon of the style's set for it when it has no art.

ownedText.description: How many the player owns, as written (348); empty hides it.

rateText.description: What it makes, as written (+1.24 M / sec); empty hides it.

cycle.description: How far its current cycle is, 0 to 1.

cycleSeconds.description: How long a cycle takes: under a quarter second the bar stays full and shimmers (too fast to read as a fill). 0 hides the bar.

costText.description: What the next purchase costs, as written (12.4 M).

currencyIcon.description: The currency's art beside the cost; null draws a coin.

affordable.description: The purse pays the purchase: the buy button lights.

buyLabel.description: The buy button's label ({n} is buyCount).

buyCount.description: How many a press buys (×1, ×10, the most the purse pays).

locked.description: Not unlocked yet: dimmed with a lock and lockedHint in place of its numbers; it cannot be bought.

IdleGeneratorResult.description: What the generator's row did this tick.

bought.description: Buy was pressed, or held long enough to repeat, and the purse pays: buy buyCount.

short.description: Buy was pressed without the purse to pay: say so (it shook).

held.description: Buy is being held: it repeats every few ticks while the purse pays.

PrestigeDesc.description: An idle game's prestige: what a reset gives and what it costs.

title.description: The panel's heading (Prestige).

lead.description: The line over the reward (Ascend for).

rewardText.description: What a reset gives, as written (+128 Shards): the panel's display line.

points.description: What a reset does, one line each with a tick (Resets generators, Permanent progression).

image.description: Its emblem (art kind emblem); null draws a crown.

available.description: A reset gives something now: the button can be held.

lockedHint.description: Why not yet, under the button while unavailable (Reach 1 Qa energy).

holdMs.description: How long the button is held to confirm: a reset is not taken by a slip.

PrestigeResult.description: What the prestige panel did this tick.

confirmed.description: The hold completed: reset the run and grant the reward.
