WalletEntry.description: One currency in a store's or a pass's purse.

key.description: Its key: its element id, so its probe path is <id>/Wallet/<key>.

name.description: Its name: what a screen reader says, and the style's icon of that name (gem, coin) when it has no art.

image.description: Its art (art kind currency); null draws the style's icon of its name, else a coin or a gem drawn as shapes.

topUp.description: It can be bought: a plus after it, answered as topUp.

StoreOffer.description: One offer of a store, as the game's viewmodel holds it.

key.description: Its key, stable while it is offered: its element id, so its probe path is <id>/Sections/<section>/Offers/<key>.

name.description: What it is called.

kind.description: A line under its name (Outfit, Bundle · 5 items).

image.description: Its art covering the tile (art kind item, splash for a featured bundle); null draws the style's placeholder.

focal.description: The art's point kept in view, fractions from the top start; null is its centre a little above the middle.

rarity.description: Its tier: the tile's rim, a wash of its colour and its name's ink.

price.description: Its price in currency; 0 with the store's freeLabel is free.

currency.description: The purse's key it is priced in; empty with priceText is real money.

priceText.description: The price as written for real money ($4.99, from the platform's store); empty writes price with the currency's icon.

original.description: The price before a discount: struck through beside it, the saving on a ribbon.

contents.description: What a bundle holds, a line each, listed on a featured tile.

badge.description: A corner tag (New, Hot, Limited); empty is none.

limit.description: How many times it can be bought; 0 is no limit. A limit shows what is left, and none left is sold out.

bought.description: How many times the player has bought it.

owned.description: Owned already (a cosmetic): a tick and the ownedLabel instead of the price; a press answers viewed.

affordable.description: The purse pays it: false draws the price in the danger ink, said short, and a press shakes and is refused.

featured.description: A featured tile: twice as wide and taller, its contents listed (a full row on a phone).

endsIn.description: Seconds until it leaves the store: a timer chip on the tile, urgent in its last hour.

StoreSection.description: A section of a store (Featured, Daily, Bundles), its offers in order.

key.description: Its key: its element id, <id>/Sections/<key>.

title.description: Its heading.

endsIn.description: Seconds until it refreshes (a daily rotation): a timer beside the heading.

offers.description: Its offers, in the order shown.

StoreFrontDesc.description: A store front: the purse, then sections of offers on rotation.

title.description: The store's title over the purse; empty shows none (the screen has its own header).

wallet.description: The purse at the head of the store, in order; empty shows none.

selected.description: The offer the game has open (its detail or confirm): drawn selected.

columns.description: Tiles a row on a desktop; 0 fits as many 220 px tiles as the width takes (two on a phone).

label.description: What a screen reader calls the store.

ownedLabel.description: An owned offer's line in place of its price.

soldOutLabel.description: An offer bought up to its limit.

leftLabel.description: What a limited offer has left ({left} of {limit}).

saveLabel.description: A discount's ribbon ({pct} is the saving in whole percent).

shortLabel.description: Said with a price the purse cannot pay.

topUpLabel.description: A currency's plus to a screen reader ({name}).

daysLabel.description: A time left of a day or more ({d} days, {h} hours).

hoursLabel.description: A time left of an hour or more ({h} hours, {m} minutes).

StoreFrontResult.description: What the store did this tick.

chosen.description: An offer pressed that can be bought: open its detail or a confirm (og.ui.confirm), then charge it and pass bought or owned back.

viewed.description: An owned offer pressed: show it (a preview, a fitting room).

refused.description: An offer pressed that cannot be bought (short or sold out): it shook and said why.

topUp.description: A currency's plus pressed: open the currency's own offers.

hovered.description: The offer under the pointer or the focus.

PassReward.description: One reward on a battle pass's track.

key.description: Its key: its element id within its tier.

name.description: What it is (Neon Outfit, 500 Coins).

amountText.description: A count on its corner (×500); empty is none.

image.description: Its art (art kind item); null draws the style's placeholder.

rarity.description: Its tier: the cell's rim and wash.

PassTier.description: One level of a battle pass: its free and premium rewards and what the player has claimed.

free.description: The free track's reward; null is none at this level.

premium.description: The premium track's reward; null is none.

milestone.description: A milestone level (every tenth, the season's outfit): its cells larger, its level badge in gold.

PassClaim.description: A reward claimed on a battle pass.

BattlePassDesc.description: A battle pass: the season, the player's level and XP, the premium track's ownership and the tiers.

title.description: The season's name (Season 4 · Neon Tide).

image.description: The season's key art behind the header (art kind banner); null draws a gradient of the style's hues.

endsIn.description: Seconds until the season ends: a timer chip in the header.

level.description: The player's level: tiers up to it can be claimed.

premium.description: The premium track is owned: its rewards can be claimed; until then they are locked.

unlockPriceText.description: The premium track's price on the unlock button ($9.99, or 950 with its currency); empty shows only the label.

label.description: What a screen reader calls the pass.

xpLabel.description: The XP toward the next level ({xp} and {need}).

claimAllLabel.description: The button claiming every reward ready ({n} of them).

unlockLabel.description: The button unlocking the premium track.

lockedLabel.description: What a premium reward adds while the track is locked.

reachLabel.description: What a reward past the player's level adds ({n}).

daysLabel.description: A time left of a day or more ({d} days, {h} hours).

hoursLabel.description: A time left of an hour or more ({h} hours, {m} minutes).

BattlePassResult.description: What the pass did this tick.

claimed.description: Rewards claimed this tick (one pressed, or every one ready with Claim all): grant them and mark them claimed.

unlock.description: Unlock Premium pressed: open its purchase.

refused.description: A reward pressed that cannot be claimed yet (past the level, or premium while locked): it shook and said why.

hovered.description: The level of the tier under the pointer or the focus.

BacklogDesc.description: A conversation's backlog, as og.story.history answers it.

title.description: Its title.

replayLabel.description: A voiced line's replay button, said to a screen reader.

BacklogResult.description: What the backlog's player did this tick.

closed.description: Close or back was pressed: hide it.

replay.description: A line's voice to play again: its StoryLine.seq (its voice is StoryLine.voice).

BarksDesc.description: The barks being said, as og.story.barks answers them.

barks.description: The barks (og.story.barks), each drawn over its entity.

height.description: World units over each speaker's point.

shoutPriority.description: A bark of this priority or higher is a shout (bold, a jagged edge).

clamp.description: A speaker off screen keeps its bubble on the edge.

LobbyMember.description: One player in the party, as the game's viewmodel holds it.

key.description: Its key, stable while it is in the party: its element id, so its probe path is <id>/Lineup/<key>.

name.description: The player's name: the card's reading, set in the display face.

title.description: A line under the name: a rank, a class, a club (empty: none).

portrait.description: Its character or avatar (art kind character), filling the card; null draws the style's placeholder figure.

ready.description: Ready: the card's foot lit in success with a tick and the ready word.

leader.description: The party's leader: a crown at the card's top start.

you.description: The local player: its card stands larger and first, its foot reads the ready toggle's state.

status.description: A line in place of the ready word (In a match, Away); empty is ready or not ready.

accepted.description: In a ready check: has accepted.

declined.description: In a ready check: has declined.

LobbyMode.description: The mode the party queues for.

name.description: Its name (Ranked, Duos, Grand Prix).

detail.description: A line under it (5v5 · Summoner's Rift; 4 players).

image.description: Its art (art kind thumbnail), 16:9; null draws the style's placeholder.

ReadyCheckView.description: A match found, waiting for every player to accept.

seconds.description: The whole time to accept, for the ring; 0 is 10.

LobbyDesc.description: A party lobby: who is in it, the mode, matchmaking and the ready check.

title.description: The screen's title (Play, Party, Lobby).

members.description: The party, the local player among them, in the game's order (the local player's card is drawn first).

slots.description: The party's size: the places past the members are empty seats, each an Invite; 0 is the members' count.

mode.description: The mode the party queues for: a card at the foot's start, pressed to change it (LobbyResult.mode).

searching.description: Matchmaking: the foot's action becomes Cancel and a chip counts the time in queue.

estimateSeconds.description: The estimated wait, said beside the count; 0 says none.

canStart.description: The local player may start matchmaking (the leader, with the party ready): the foot's action is Find match; else it is the ready toggle.

readyCheck.description: A match found: the ready check stands over the lobby until the game clears it.

readyLabel.description: The ready word on a card, and the toggle once ready.

notReadyLabel.description: The word on a card not ready.

leaderLabel.description: The leader, to a screen reader.

LobbyResult.description: What the lobby was asked this tick, for the game to do.

ready.description: The ready toggle was pressed: flip the local player's ready.

invite.description: An empty seat was pressed: its place, from 0 at the first empty seat.

member.description: A member's card was pressed: the game's menu for it (profile, promote, kick).

mode.description: The mode card was pressed: open the mode select.

accept.description: The ready check was accepted (its button, or confirm).

decline.description: The ready check was declined (its button, or Back).

RosterEntry.description: One character on a select screen's roster.

key.description: Its key: its tile's element id, so its probe path is <id>/Stage/Roster/Row#<r>/<key>.

name.description: Its name, large over its splash when a cursor is on it.

role.description: Its role or class (Duelist, Grappler, Support): the eyebrow over the name.

portrait.description: Its tile's art (art kind portrait), the face filling the tile; null draws the style's placeholder figure.

splash.description: Its full art (art kind splash) standing large on its player's side; null takes the portrait.

locked.description: Not owned or not unlocked: the tile dark with a lock; a press is refused and says why.

lockedHint.description: Why it is locked (Unlock at level 10).

taken.description: Picked by another player of the local player's team: the tile dimmed, a press refused.

description.description: A line under the name on its splash (its play style).

SelectCursor.description: One player's cursor on the roster.

key.description: The player's key (p1, p2).

name.description: The player's name or slot (P1, Mira): its tag on the tile and over its splash.

entry.description: The roster key its cursor is on (empty: none yet).

confirmed.description: Locked in: its tile wears the tick and its splash its lock.

team.description: Its team, for its colour (the style's team roles).

you.description: The local player: keys, pads and the pointer move this cursor (SelectResult.hovered).

CharacterSelectDesc.description: A character select: the roster, the players' cursors and the words.

title.description: The screen's title (Choose your fighter).

roster.description: The roster in its order: the grid fills rows from the start.

cursors.description: The players' cursors: the local player's splash stands on the start side; with two players, the other's on the end side.

columns.description: Tiles a row; 0 fits as many 96 px tiles as the grid's width holds (four on a phone in portrait).

secondsLeft.description: Time left to pick, shown as a timer over the grid; a negative value shows none.

randomLabel.description: The random pick's tile; empty shows none.

CharacterSelectResult.description: What the local player asked for this tick, for the game to apply.

hovered.description: The roster key under the pointer or the focus: move the local player's cursor to it (a fighting game's cursor follows the stick).

picked.description: A character pressed or confirmed (its tile, or Lock in on the cursor's): lock it in.

random.description: The random tile was pressed: pick one for the player.

refused.description: A locked or taken character pressed: it shook.

cancelled.description: Back while locked in: unlock the pick.

VersusSide.description: One side of a versus screen.

name.description: The player's or team's name, in the display face.

character.description: The character's name, over the player's.

splash.description: The character's full art (art kind splash), filling the side; null draws the style's placeholder figure.

detail.description: A line under the name (a rank, a record: 12W 3L).

VersusDesc.description: A versus screen: two sides, the stage, the words.

stage.description: The stage or mode under the mark (Round 1 · Skyreach Gate).

progress.description: Loading progress, 0 to 1, as a bar along the foot; a negative value shows none.

skipLabel.description: The skip hint; empty takes no skip.

VersusResult.description: What the versus screen was asked this tick.

skipped.description: Confirm, Back or a press asked to go on.

DraftSlot.description: One pick of a team in a draft.

entry.description: The roster key picked or hovered (empty: none yet).

locked.description: The pick is locked in: the slot shows the character whole; else a hover shows it dimmed.

active.description: This slot picks now: lit, with the timer's light along it.

name.description: The team's name (Blue side).

bans.description: Its bans, roster keys in ban order; an empty key is a ban still to come.

DraftDesc.description: A draft: two teams' picks and bans, the roster, the phase and its timer.

teams.description: The two teams, the local player's first (it stands on the start side).

roster.description: The roster: taken (picked by anyone) and banned characters are told by the teams' lists.

phase.description: ban, pick or done: what the active slot does (Ban in danger, Lock in in the accent).

phaseLabel.description: The banner over the roster (Ban phase · Blue bans 2).

seconds.description: The turn's whole time, for the bar; 0 is 30.

yourTurn.description: The local player acts now: the roster takes presses and the action is live.

hovered.description: The roster key the local player has hovered (its slot shows it dimmed, its tile is rimmed).

columns.description: Tiles a row; 0 fits 88 px tiles.

waitingLabel.description: The action while it is not the local player's turn.

bannedLabel.description: A banned character, to a screen reader.

pickedLabel.description: A picked character, to a screen reader.

DraftResult.description: What the local player asked for this tick, for the game to apply.

hovered.description: An open character pressed or focused in the local player's turn: hover it (its slot shows it).

locked.description: The action, or confirm, on the hovered character: lock it in (a pick or a ban by the phase).

refused.description: A banned or picked character pressed: it shook.

WorldMarker.description: One place on the world map.

key.description: Its key: its pin's element id, so its probe path is <id>/Map/Pins/<key>.

kind.description: What it is, for its pin's mark and the legend: quest, objective, fastTravel, shop, poi, boss, custom (any other word is a poi).

name.description: Its name: the pin's label when zoomed in, and the detail's title.

description.description: The detail's line (what is there, the quest's step).

discovered.description: Found: undiscovered places show as a faint mark under the fog and cannot be travelled to.

tracked.description: The tracked quest's or the custom waypoint: its pin rings and pulses.

image.description: The detail's picture (art kind thumbnail); null shows none.

WorldRegion.description: A region of the world: its name on the map, and its fog until discovered.

key.description: Its key.

name.description: Its name, set across the map at its centre in the display face's caps.

x.description: Its centre across the map, 0 to 1.

y.description: Its centre down the map, 0 to 1.

radius.description: How far its fog reaches, as a fraction of the map's width; 0 is 0.18.

discovered.description: Discovered: its fog is lifted and its name shown; else a cloud of fog over it and its name ???.

WorldMapDesc.description: A world map: the art, the regions and their fog, the places, the player.

texture.description: The map's art (art kind map); null draws the style's well with a grid.

aspect.description: The map's width over its height; 0 is 16:9.

regions.description: The regions: their names and their fog.

playerX.description: The player's place across the map, 0 to 1; a negative value draws no player.

playerY.description: The player's place down the map, 0 to 1.

heading.description: The player's facing, clockwise from north.

selected.description: The place whose detail is open (the game's: it passes WorldMapResult.selected back).

hidden.description: Kinds the legend has turned off: their pins are not drawn.

title.description: The map's title over the legend (the realm's name).

travelLabel.description: The detail's action on a discovered fast-travel point.

trackLabel.description: The detail's action on another place.

untrackLabel.description: The detail's action on the tracked place.

undiscoveredLabel.description: An undiscovered place's or region's name.

kindLabels.description: The legend's word for each kind, `{ quest: "Quests" }`; a kind without one shows its key.

closeLabel.description: The detail's close, to a screen reader.

WorldMapResult.description: What the map was asked this tick, and where it is.

selected.description: A pin was pressed (its key), or the detail was closed (empty): open or close its detail.

travel.description: Fast travel was pressed on a discovered fast-travel point.

track.description: Set or Remove waypoint was pressed: flip that place's tracking.

toggled.description: A legend entry was pressed: show or hide that kind's pins.

zoom.description: The map's zoom (1: the whole map).

centerX.description: The middle of what it shows across the map, 0 to 1.

centerY.description: The middle of what it shows down the map, 0 to 1.

key.description: Its key (easy, expert).

name.description: Its name on its chip (Easy, Expert).

locked.description: Not playable yet: the chip dimmed with a lock.

key.description: Its key: its row's element id, so its probe path is <id>/Wheel/<key>.

title.description: Its title, the row's reading and the detail's heading.

jacket.description: Its cover art (art kind jacket), square; null draws the style's placeholder.

best.description: The best score on the selected chart; 0 shows none.

grade.description: The best grade on the selected chart (S, A); empty shows none.

fullCombo.description: The selected chart was cleared with a full combo: a badge beside the grade.

accuracy.description: The best accuracy on the selected chart, 0 to 1; a negative value shows none.

locked.description: Not unlocked: its row dimmed with a lock, and Play refused.

isNew.description: Not played yet: a New tag on its row.

SongPreview.description: The selected song's preview, which the game plays (og.audio).

playing.description: The preview is playing: the bar's play mark is a pause and its played part lit.

position.description: How far into the song the preview is.

peaks.description: The song's waveform, its peaks 0 to 1 across its length (64 to 128 of them); empty draws a flat line.

SongSelectDesc.description: A song select: the songs, the selected one and chart, the preview.

songs.description: The songs, in the wheel's order.

selected.description: The song the wheel stands on (the game's: it passes SongSelectResult.selected back).

previewLabel.description: The preview's play toggle, to a screen reader.

SongSelectResult.description: What the player asked for this tick, for the game to apply.

selected.description: Another song was focused or pressed: stand the wheel on it (and start its preview).

difficulty.description: Another chart was pressed, or the tab actions (Q and E, the bumpers) stepped to it.

play.description: Play was pressed, or the selected song's row pressed again, or confirm on it: start the chart.

preview.description: The preview's toggle was pressed: play or pause it.

refused.description: A locked song or chart was asked to play: it shook.

LedgerFigure.description: One headline figure over the ledger (Balance, Income, Expenses, Population).

key.description: Its key: its tile's element id.

label.description: Its name, the tile's caption.

delta.description: Its change since the last period, shown signed with an arrow; 0 shows none.

format.description: How the value and the change are written (grouped by default).

unit.description: A unit after the value (a currency's sign is the game's, in the label or the unit).

image.description: Its art (art kind itemIcon) on the tile; null shows none.

lowerIsBetter.description: A fall is good news (expenses, debt, crime): the change's colour turns over.

LedgerSection.description: A section of the ledger's lines (Income, Expenses; Revenue, Upkeep).

key.description: Its key: the lines' `section`.

name.description: Its heading, with its total.

expense.description: Its lines cost money: their total is taken from the net, and its change's colour turns over.

LedgerLine.description: One line of the ledger: a tax, a service, a department, a contract.

key.description: Its key: its row's element id, so its probe path is <id>/Body/Ledger/List/<key>.

name.description: Its name, the row's reading.

image.description: Its art (art kind itemIcon) at the row's start; null draws the style's placeholder mark.

amount.description: Its amount this period (positive; the section says which way it runs).

previous.description: Its amount last period, for its change; a negative value shows none.

funding.description: Its budget or tax rate as a slider in percent; a negative value shows no slider (a fixed line).

warning.description: A problem with it (Underfunded: crime rising), shown with a warning mark; empty shows none.

locked.description: Its slider cannot move yet (a policy not unlocked): shown inert with a lock.

LedgerTab.description: One of the ledger's periods or views (Month, Quarter, Year).

key.description: Its key.

label.description: Its word.

key.description: The line.

LedgerDesc.description: A management ledger: the headline figures, the lines by section with their budgets, and the history graph.

title.description: The screen's title (Budget); empty shows none (the game titles it).

tabs.description: The periods or views; empty shows no tabs.

figures.description: The headline figures, start to end.

lines.description: The lines, each in its section, in the game's order (the ledger sorts them by `sort`).

sort.description: The column the lines are sorted by within each section: name, amount, change, or empty for the game's order.

descending.description: The sort runs high to low.

fundingMin.description: The sliders' low end, in percent.

fundingMax.description: The sliders' high end, in percent.

periods.description: The history's categories, oldest first (the months).

history.description: The history's series over the periods (income, expenses, balance); empty shows no graph.

graph.description: How the history is drawn (a line by default).

breakdown.description: A section whose lines' shares are drawn as a donut beside the history; empty shows none.

currency.description: The money's sign, written before amounts ($, ¥); empty writes bare numbers.

totalLabel.description: Said before a section's total, and the net's caption.

netLabel.description: The net line's caption at the ledger's foot.

otherLabel.description: The donut's line for the smaller lines it folds together when the legend would not fit its card.

lockedLabel.description: A locked slider, to a screen reader.

LedgerResult.description: What the player asked for this tick, for the game to apply.

sort.description: A column's heading was pressed: sort by it (the same column again turns the order over).

selected.description: A line was pressed (the game may open its detail or its overlay).

MapOverlay.description: One of the map's data overlays (Traffic, Power, Land value), with its legend's ramp.

key.description: Its key: its button's element id.

name.description: Its name, under its art and to a screen reader.

image.description: Its art (art kind itemIcon) on the button; null draws the style's placeholder mark.

ramp.description: The legend's colours from low to high (`#rrggbb`), as the game draws the overlay on its map.

low.description: The legend's word at the low end (Free flowing).

high.description: The legend's word at the high end (Gridlock).

OverlayBarDesc.description: A city or strategy map's overlay picker: the overlays, the one shown and its legend.

selected.description: The overlay shown on the map; empty shows none.

label.description: The bar's name, to a screen reader.

offLabel.description: The button turning the overlay off, to a screen reader.

OverlayBarResult.description: What the player asked for this tick.

selected.description: An overlay was pressed: show it (the empty string: the shown one was pressed again, turn it off).

ChatChannel.description: One chat channel (General, Party, Guild, Whispers, Trade): a tab, and an ink its messages wear.

key.description: Its key: its tab's element id (<id>/Tabs/Row/<key>), and the messages' `channel`.

name.description: Its name on its tab and in the tag before its messages where several channels show.

color.description: Its ink: a theme colour's name (info, success) or `#rrggbb`; empty is the ink.

unread.description: Messages the player has not seen in it: a count on its tab.

mentions.description: Unread messages naming the player: its tab's count turns to the highlight.

all.description: The tab that shows every channel's messages, each tagged with its channel.

readOnly.description: No sending to it (System, Combat log): the input's channel skips it.

ChatLink.description: A link inside a message: an item, a player, a place or a quest, which a press answers by its key.

key.description: Its key, answered in ChatResult.link.

label.description: Its words, shown in brackets ([Ashbringer]).

kind.description: What it links (item, player, place, quest), to a screen reader.

rarity.description: An item's tier: the link's ink (common shows the accent).

ChatMessage.description: One message, as the game holds it. Its words are shown as they were typed: no markup is read in them.

key.description: Its key: its line's element id, so its probe path is <id>/Log/<key>.

channel.description: The channel it was said in.

author.description: Who said it; empty for a system line.

authorKey.description: The author's key, answered in ChatResult.author when their name is pressed (a whisper, a profile).

avatar.description: The author's portrait (art kind portrait) at the line's start; null shows none.

text.description: The words. `{0}`, `{1}` stand for its links in order; `@Name` naming a member is a mention.

links.description: Its links, by their place in the text.

time.description: When, as the game writes it (12:04); empty shows none.

system.description: A notice from the game (Kael joined the party): muted, with no author.

ChatMember.description: Someone a mention can name: the suggestions while an @ word is typed.

key.description: Their key.

name.description: Their name as a mention writes it.

avatar.description: Their portrait (art kind portrait) in the suggestion; null shows none.

text.description: Its words, trimmed.

ChatDesc.description: A chat window: the channels, the messages, the player's draft and the channel it goes to.

title.description: The window's title; empty shows none.

messages.description: The messages, oldest first (the game keeps its own limit).

me.description: The local player's name: a message mentioning @me is lit.

draft.description: The input's text (the game's: it passes ChatResult.draft back).

sendTo.description: The channel the input sends to; empty is the tab shown (or the first one that can be sent to).

hud.description: The HUD's chat (World of Warcraft, Valorant): no panel, the newest lines over the game on a soft shade, fading after `fadeAfter` seconds unless the pointer is over it; the tabs and the input show while `typing`.

typing.description: With hud: the player is writing (the game opens the input with Enter and closes it on a send or Back).

fadeAfter.description: With hud: seconds a line stays before it fades.

newLabel.description: The pill over the log when newer messages are below the view ({n} is how many).

channelLabel.description: The input's channel chip, to a screen reader.

ChatResult.description: What the player asked for this tick, for the game to apply.

sendTo.description: The input's channel chip was pressed: the next channel that can be sent to.

draft.description: The input's text changed (typed, or a mention suggestion inserted).

send.description: Enter or Send with words in the input (the game posts it and clears the draft).

link.description: A link was pressed: its key.

author.description: An author's name was pressed: their key.

closed.description: With hud and typing: Back was pressed (the game closes the input).

PhotoTab.description: One tab of photo mode's controls (Camera, Lens, Filters, Frames).

key.description: Its key: its tab's element id; the controls' `tab`. The keys `filters` and `frames` show the filter and frame tiles.

label.description: Its word.

PhotoControl.description: One slider of photo mode (field of view, roll, focus distance, aperture, exposure, vignette).

key.description: Its key: its row's element id.

label.description: Its name.

step.description: Its step; 0 is continuous.

unit.description: A unit after its value (°, m, EV; a word's unit stands after a space); `%` writes a 0-to-1 value as a percent.

origin.description: A centre the fill grows from (roll 0, exposure 0); null fills from the low end.

PhotoLook.description: A filter or a frame: its tile shows the picture as it would come out.

key.description: Its key: its tile's element id.

name.description: Its name under the tile.

image.description: Its thumbnail (the game's own render of the shot through it); null draws the style's placeholder.

tint.description: A wash over the thumbnail (`#rrggbbaa`) where the game has no render of its own; empty is none.

key.description: The control.

PhotoModeDesc.description: Photo mode's controls over the game's paused, free camera: the tabs, the sliders, the filters and frames, the grid and the shutter.

controls.description: Every slider, each under its tab.

filters.description: The filters, for the tab `filters`; the first is usually None.

filter.description: The filter applied (the game draws it).

strength.description: The filter's strength, 0 to 1, a slider under the tiles; null shows none.

frameImage.description: The chosen frame's art drawn over the whole picture (transparent where the picture shows); null draws none.

grid.description: The rule of thirds over the picture.

hidden.description: The controls are hidden for a clean shot: only a quiet hint stays, and any press, Back or the hide action brings them back.

flashMs.description: How long the shutter's flash lasts after Capture.

title.description: The panel's title.

hiddenHint.default: Press any key to show the controls

PhotoModeResult.description: What the player asked for this tick, for the game to apply.

tab.description: Another tab was pressed (or the tab actions stepped).

grid.description: The grid's toggle was pressed: flip it.

hide.description: Hide UI was pressed (or the details action), or the hidden controls were asked back: flip `hidden`.

capture.description: The shutter was pressed, or confirm while hidden: the game takes the shot (the flash plays here).

reset.description: Reset was pressed: the sliders to their defaults.

exit.description: Exit or Back was pressed (Back while hidden only brings the controls back).

CollectionCard.description: One card of the collection, as the game holds it: the face og.ui.cardHand draws, the copies owned and in the deck.

key.description: Its key: its tile's element id (<id>/Collection/Grid/Line#<n>/<key>) and its deck row's (<id>/Deck/List/<key>).

name.description: Its name, on its banner and its deck row.

cost.description: Its cost, the gem; null has none. The curve counts it (7 and up in the last bar).

typeLine.description: Its type line on the face (Spell, Unit).

kind.description: Its kind's key, for the kind filter and the deck's counts (unit, spell).

text.description: Its rules (rich text), shown on the large face of the card hovered or focused.

image.description: Its art (art kind cardArt); null draws the style's placeholder.

rarity.description: Its tier: the frame's colour, the rarity filter and the deck row's mark.

owned.description: Copies owned: the tile's ×N; none dims the tile and it cannot be added.

count.description: Copies in the deck: its deck row's count.

limit.description: Copies a deck may hold; 0 is the deck's copyLimit.

DeckKind.description: A card kind: a filter chip and a line of the deck's counts.

key.description: Its key, as the cards' kind.

label.description: Its word (Units).

image.description: Its mark (art kind icon); null shows the word alone.

DeckRarity.description: A tier the rarity filter offers.

label.description: Its word (Rare).

DeckSort.description: An order the collection can be sorted in: `cost`, `name`, `rarity` and `owned` are known; another key keeps the game's order.

key.description: Its key.

label.description: Its word.

DeckBuilderDesc.description: A deck builder over the collection: the filters, the collection's grid, the deck's list, its curve and counts, Done.

title.description: The screen's title (Collection).

cards.description: Every card of the collection, in the game's order; the filters and the sort are applied here.

deckName.description: The deck's name, at the head of its list.

deckImage.description: The deck's art behind its name (art kind cardArt); null shows none.

deckSize.description: The cards a deck holds: the count's whole (30/30), and the limit a card past it is refused at.

copyLimit.description: Copies of one card a deck may hold, unless the card says otherwise.

costFilter.description: The cost shown, the last chip (7) meaning that and up; -1 all.

search.description: The search's text: names that hold it, whatever the case.

sort.description: The sort's key; empty keeps the game's order.

rarities.description: The tiers the rarity filter offers.

kinds.description: The kinds: the filter's chips and the deck's counts.

view.description: On a phone in portrait, the half shown: `deck` the deck, else the collection.

collectionLabel.description: The collection's tab on a phone, and its count's word ({owned} / {total} cards).

fullLabel.description: Said when a card is refused for a full deck.

limitLabel.description: Said when a card is refused at its copies' limit.

unownedLabel.description: Said for a card not owned.

emptyLabel.description: The grid's word when no card passes the filters.

DeckBuilderResult.description: What the player asked for this tick, for the game to apply.

add.description: A collection card was pressed and the deck can take it: add a copy.

remove.description: A deck row was pressed: take a copy out.

refused.description: A card was pressed that the deck cannot take (full, at its limit, not owned): it shakes and the reason shows.

costFilter.description: A cost chip was pressed (-1 all).

rarityFilter.description: A tier chip was pressed (none all).

kindFilter.description: A kind chip was pressed (empty all).

view.description: On a phone, the other half's tab was pressed.

GalleryChapter.description: One chapter of a CG gallery or a route chart: its tab, or its column's heading.

key.description: Its key: its tab's element id (<id>/Tabs/Row/<key>).

label.description: Its word (Chapter 1, Common route).

CgEntry.description: One event picture (CG) of the gallery, as the save holds it.

key.description: Its key: its tile's element id (<id>/Grid/Line#<n>/<key>).

title.description: Its title under the tile and in the viewer; a locked one shows lockedLabel instead.

chapter.description: The chapter it belongs to: the tabs filter by it; empty shows it under every tab.

image.description: Its picture (art kind cg); null draws the style's placeholder.

variants.description: Its other versions (an expression, the night), the viewer's pips stepping through them after image.

locked.description: Not seen yet: the tile is veiled with a lock and its hint, and the viewer will not open it.

hint.description: How to unlock it, under a locked tile (Clear Mira's route); empty shows the lock alone.

fresh.description: Unlocked since the gallery was last opened: a New mark on the tile.

CgGalleryDesc.description: A visual novel's CG gallery: the chapters as tabs, the pictures as tiles with the locked ones veiled, and the viewer.

title.description: The gallery's title.

chapters.description: The chapters; fewer than two shows no tabs.

entries.description: Every picture, in the game's order.

viewing.description: The picture open in the viewer; empty shows the grid.

variant.description: The version open in the viewer: 0 the image, then each of variants.

CgGalleryResult.description: What the player asked for this tick, for the game to apply.

chapter.description: Another chapter's tab was pressed (or the tab actions stepped).

open.description: An unlocked tile was pressed: open it in the viewer (at variant 0).

refused.description: A locked tile was pressed: it shakes.

close.description: The viewer's close, Back, or a press on the picture while its chrome is hidden.

step.description: The viewer's previous or next (or Left and Right): the unlocked picture to open, wrapping, skipping the locked.

variant.description: A variant's pip was pressed (or Up and Down stepped).

RouteScene.description: One scene of a route chart, placed by the game on the chart's grid.

key.description: Its key: its card's element id (<id>/Chart/Map/<key>).

title.description: Its title on its card; a locked one shows lockedLabel instead.

image.description: Its thumbnail (art kind cg); null draws the style's placeholder.

column.description: Its column, left to right in story order (mirrored right to left).

lane.description: Its lane, top to bottom: a branch takes another lane.

seen.description: Played: its card is lit and it can be jumped to.

locked.description: Not reached: a veiled card with a lock; pressing it is refused.

current.description: Where the story stands now: a ring in the focus colour and a mark.

ending.description: An ending's word (Good end, Bad end); empty is no ending. Its card carries a band in the ending's colour.

good.description: With ending: a good ending's colour (success), else danger.

label.description: The choice that takes it, on the line at the fork; empty shows none.

taken.description: Taken in a play: drawn lit and thicker; else thin and dim.

RouteChartDesc.description: A visual novel's route flowchart: the scenes on their grid, the branches between them, the detail of the selected scene.

title.description: The chart's title.

chapters.description: A heading over each column, in order; empty shows none.

selected.description: The scene selected: its detail at the side (under the chart on a phone).

jumpLabel.description: The detail's jump to the scene.

RouteChartResult.description: What the player asked for this tick, for the game to apply.

selected.description: Another scene's card was pressed: select it.

jump.description: The detail's jump was pressed on a seen scene: the game loads it.

refused.description: A locked scene was pressed: it shakes.

SettingKind.description: What a settings entry is: the control its row draws.

x-og-variants.slider: A number in a range: a slider (`value`, min, max, step, unit).
x-og-variants.choice: One of a few words: a segmented control up to four, else a dropdown (`index` of options).
x-og-variants.binding: An input action's keys and buttons: og.ui.keyBindingRow, bound by physical key code and shown by the layout's label (the pattern's world).
x-og-variants.action: A button that does something now (Reset tutorials, Calibrate).
x-og-variants.custom: A row whose control the game builds: the custom callback, called with the entry's key inside the row.

SettingEntry.description: One entry of a settings page, as data: a game adds, drops or reorders entries without touching the pattern.

key.description: Its key: its row's element id (<id>/Page/Rows/<key>) and the key of its change.

label.description: Its name.

description.description: What it does: shown in the detail panel while its row is hovered or focused.

section.description: A heading drawn above it where it differs from the entry before; empty is none.

step.description: A slider's step; 0 is continuous.

unit.description: A slider's unit after its value; `%` writes a 0-to-1 value as a percent.

action.description: A binding's input action (its name in the action map).

display.description: A display change (fullscreen, render scale, frame cap): applying it starts the confirm-or-revert countdown.

dirty.description: Changed and not yet applied: a mark beside its name.

disabled.description: Shown but not to be changed (the backend cannot), with its description saying why.

preview.description: A picture of its effect (art kind banner, 16:9) under its description in the detail panel; none draws no picture.

SettingsPage.description: One page of the settings tree: a tab, and its entries in order.

key.description: Its key: its tab's element id (<id>/Tabs/Row/<key>).

label.description: Its word.

entries.description: Its entries; empty with hud draws the HUD layout page.

hud.description: The HUD layout page: a note, Edit HUD (which turns og.ui.setHudEdit on) and, while editing, og.ui.hudLayoutEditor itself.

SettingChange.description: One entry changed by the player this tick.

key.description: The entry.

SettingsTreeDesc.description: The settings as a tree of pages and typed entries, the pending state, and the confirm countdown.

title.description: The screen's title.

pending.description: Some entry is changed and not applied: Apply and Revert are live.

confirmSeconds.description: A display change was applied: the countdown's seconds left (0 none). At 0 after counting the result says revert.

confirmTotal.description: The countdown's whole, for its ring.

defaultsLabel.description: The page back to its defaults.

hudNote.default: Move, resize and fade the HUD's elements over the game.

changedLabel.description: Said of a changed entry to a screen reader.

SettingsTreeResult.description: What the player asked for this tick, for the game to apply to its settings.

page.description: Another page's tab was pressed (or the tab actions stepped).

change.description: An entry's control changed: the game holds it as pending (or applies it at once).

bindingChanged.description: A binding row rebound an action (the action map is already changed).

apply.description: Apply was pressed: the game applies the pending entries, and starts the countdown if any is a display change.

revert.description: Revert was pressed: the game drops the pending entries.

defaults.description: Defaults was pressed: the game sets the page's entries to their defaults, pending.

keep.description: Keep was pressed during the countdown: the display change stays.

confirmRevert.description: The countdown's Revert was pressed, Back during it, or it reached 0: the game puts the display settings back.

hudDone.description: The HUD editor's Done was pressed.

UiProp.description: An animatable value of an element (docs/ui.md §7.1): a state, a timeline key, a presence or og.ui.animate moves it. Colours are sRGB components 0 to 1; rotation and skew are radians.

x-og-variants.x: Its horizontal offset, CSS px (the transform's x).
x-og-variants.rotate: Its turn, radians, clockwise on screen.
x-og-variants.opacity: Its opacity, 0 to 1, multiplied down the tree.
x-og-variants.z: Its z among its siblings (stepped, never tweened).
x-og-variants.inert: 1: it and its subtree take no input (stepped): a results screen's buttons wait for the sequence.

LayoutMode.description: How a container lays out its children.

x-og-variants.flex: The row and column walks of its direction (the default).
x-og-variants.stack: Children overlaid in the same rectangle, each placed by its insets, else by the container's align (across) and cross (down): a card's art, frame, cost gem and name.

x-og-variants.absolute: Out of the flow, placed by its insets inside its parent's padding box.
x-og-variants.screen: Out of the flow, placed by its insets in the whole surface rather than its parent's box: under the notch, the status bar and the home bar. A screen document's full-bleed art or backdrop, whose layer keeps its content in the safe area.
x-og-variants.anchored: Out of the flow, its anchorSelf point on the anchorAt point of the element at anchorTo, moved by its start and top insets.

GridFlow.description: Which way auto-placed items fill a grid.

DragAxis.description: Which way a drag moves its element.

x-og-variants.lock: Either, locked to the first one the drag moves along.

x-og-variants.out: How things arrive: fast, then settling (the default).
x-og-variants.exit: How things leave: slow, then away.

MotionToken.description: A named motion of the style (docs/ui.md §7.7): components use these, so a style's personality changes every motion at once.

x-og-variants.ui: The control spring: hover, press, toggles.

ReducedMotion.description: What an animation does under reduced motion (docs/ui.md §7.7).

x-og-variants.fade: Movement and scale jump; opacity and colour fade quickly (the default).
x-og-variants.none: Everything jumps.
x-og-variants.keep: Plays as authored: motion that carries meaning, kept small.

x-og-variants.pingPong: Forward then back, over and over.

UiTransform.description: A transform applied after layout, about its pivot: CSS's translate(x, y) rotate(r) skew(kx, ky) scale(sx, sy) with its transform-origin. Hit tests, the probe's rectangles and the accessibility tree's bounds follow it; layout does not.

rotate.description: Its turn, radians, clockwise on screen.

pivotX.description: The pivot across its box (0 its start edge, 1 its end).

Edges.description: Insets of an absolute or anchored element from its parent's edges; an absent one is not set. start and end follow the writing direction: a right-to-left layout mirrors them.

centerX.description: Centred across the parent (start, if given, moves it).

centerY.description: Centred down the parent (top, if given, moves it).

TrackFr.description: A share of the space the other tracks leave.

TrackRange.description: A track sized by its content, within bounds.

TrackPercent.description: A fraction of the grid's inner size.

oneOf.description: A share of the free space.
Its content between min and max.

rows.description: The row tracks; items past them add autoTrack rows.

autoTrack.description: The track added for items past the declared ones; null is auto.

columnGap.description: Space between columns; absent is the element's gap.

rowGap.description: Space between rows; absent is the element's gap.

areas.description: Named areas, one string per row of space-separated cell names, as CSS grid-template-areas (`.` is an unnamed cell).

flow.description: Which way auto-placed items fill it.

dense.description: Auto-placement back-fills holes left by spanning items.

GridPlace.description: Where an item sits in its parent grid; the zero value is auto-placed in one cell.

area.description: A named area of the grid (wins over the numbers).

PropValue.description: A value for an animatable prop.

UiQuery.description: When a variant applies: every condition given must hold.

breakpoints.description: The size classes it applies on (empty: any).

orientation.description: The orientation it applies in; null is either.

minWidth.description: The narrowest width it applies at (0: unbounded): the viewport's, or with container the element's own laid-out width.

container.description: A container query: the widths are the element's own (the same card in a four-column shop and a one-column phone list).

UiPatch.description: What a variant changes: the box's layout, its arrangement and animatable values; absent fields are unchanged.

hidden.description: Hide it and its subtree where the variant applies.

UiVariant.description: A prop override under a condition (docs/ui.md §6.2: breakpoint variants and container queries). Later variants win.

SpringSpec.description: A spring by how it feels: about how long it takes to settle and how much it overshoots. Retargeting it keeps its value and velocity, so an interrupted motion never jumps.

durationMs.description: About how long it takes to arrive, ms.

bounce.description: 0 arrives without overshoot; 0.3 overshoots a little; up to 1 rings (below 0 is sluggish). The style's overshoot caps it.

TweenSpec.description: A duration on an ease: a retarget starts a new ease from where it is.

bezier.description: A cubic Bézier (x1, y1, x2, y2) in place of the named ease (empty: the named one).

TokenRef.description: One of the style's motion tokens.

Transition.description: How a value moves to a new target.

oneOf.description: On a spring that keeps its velocity.

durationMs.description: About how long it takes to arrive, ms.

bounce.description: 0 arrives without overshoot; 0.3 overshoots a little; up to 1 rings (below 0 is sluggish). The style's overshoot caps it.

oneOf.description: Over a duration on an ease.

bezier.description: A cubic Bézier (x1, y1, x2, y2) in place of the named ease (empty: the named one).

DismissSpec.description: Swipe to dismiss: a release past distance (or faster than velocity) along the drag's axis throws the element off.

distance.description: 0: 40 % of its size along the axis.

SnapPoint.description: An offset a released drag can settle on.

DragSpec.description: The element moves with a drag that starts on it (a card, a sheet, a carousel), released onto a spring that keeps the drag's velocity.

bounds.description: Bounds of its offset (x to x + width, y to y + height); null is free.

rubber.description: Past the bounds it follows with resistance, iOS's rubber band with this constant (0 stops at the bounds; 0.55 is iOS's).

snap.description: Offsets a release settles on: the nearest to where its momentum would carry it.

momentum.description: A release projects the offset by its velocity (0.3 s of it) before choosing a snap point: a flick.

returnHome.description: Without snap points, a release goes back to offset 0.

dismiss.description: Swipe to dismiss; null never throws it off.

threshold.description: Pointer travel before a press becomes a drag (0: 4).

spring.description: The release spring; null is the style's ui spring.

tag.description: What a drop target matches in DropSpec.accept.

PinchSpec.description: Two touches on the element scale (and turn) it.

DropSpec.description: The element takes drops of dragged elements.

accept.description: The drag tags it takes (empty: any).

PresenceSpec.description: How an element arrives or leaves (docs/ui.md §7.5): the values it enters from or exits to, and how it moves between them and its own.

kind.description: A transition kind's values in place of values: what the kind enters from and exits to.

distance.description: A slide kind's distance (0: 24).

transition.description: How it moves; null is the style's enter or exit token.

delayMs.description: Wait this long before moving (a hand-built stagger).

VisualState.description: One state of a group: the values it sets, and timelines it starts.

name.description: Its name.

onEnter.description: A timeline (og.ui.defineTimeline) played on the element when the state is entered (empty: none).

onExit.description: One played when it is left.

StateTransition.description: The transition between two states of a group (`*` matches any state). The exact pair wins, then `* -> to`, `from -> *`, `* -> *`.

StateGroup.description: A visual state group (docs/ui.md §7.3): one of its states is current, and moving between them animates every value that changes. A group named interaction is derived from input: normal, hover, pressed, focused and disabled (a state the group lacks falls back: pressed to hover to normal, focused to hover). Other groups take their state from ElementProps.state, a timeline's state event or og.ui.forceState; the first state is the default.

name.description: Its name.

transitions.description: Its transitions; a pair without one moves on the element's motion, else the style's ui spring.

StateValue.description: The current state of a group.

NavLinks.description: Explicit focus moves from an element (docs/ui.md §8.3), over the spatial pick: each a path (a full one, `Hud/Bag`, or a sibling's id); empty leaves that move to the layout. A path to a focus group lands on its remembered member (or its first); one to any other container, on its first focusable control.

left.description: Where Left goes (the screen's left, also under a right-to-left layout).

FocusGroup.description: A container whose focusable controls are one group for keys and pads (docs/ui.md §8.3): arrows move among its members first. At its edge a group that wraps goes round to its far side; one that does not leaves for the nearest control outside that way (the group around it first) and stays put when there is none. The zero value neither wraps nor remembers.

wrap.description: At its edge the focus wraps round inside it.

memory.description: Focus coming into it from outside lands on the member it last had.

GestureSpec.description: Tap, double tap and long press on any element (docs/ui.md §8.5), answered by Response (tapped, doubleTapped, longPressed, longPress), og.ui.gesture and the frame's motion events. Nested elements compete for one press: of those that declare a gesture, the highest priority wins it, the innermost of equals. A tap waits for a double tap only where one is declared; a long press that fires takes the press, so its release clicks nothing; travel past the slop (a drag, a scroll) fails all three. The zero value recognises nothing.

doubleTap.description: Recognise a double tap (its tap then waits for the double tap's window).

longPress.description: Recognise a long press (the touch tooltip, a context menu).

longPressMs.description: How long a long press is held; 0 is 500.

doubleTapMs.description: The longest gap between a double tap's taps; 0 is 300.

slop.description: Pointer travel that fails a tap and a long press; 0 is 10.

priority.description: Among nested elements' recognisers of one press: higher wins (ties: the innermost).

Customize.description: An element the player can move, scale and fade in the HUD edit mode (docs/ui.md §8.4): a HUD group, a touch stick or button. Its placement is kept per player under key (og.ui.hudLayout). The zero value allows all three, from half to twice its size and down to a fifth of its opacity.

key.description: Its name in the saved layout; empty is its path. Name it when its path may change between versions of the game.

lockMove.description: It stays where it is laid out.

minScale.description: The smallest it scales to; 0 is 0.5.

maxScale.description: The largest it scales to; 0 is 2.

minOpacity.description: The faintest it fades to; 0 is 0.2.

Cursor.description: The pointer's shape over an element (CSS cursor, docs/ui.md §6.1), inherited by its subtree.

x-og-variants.auto: Its parent's; with none set above it, a text control's I-beam, a draggable element's open hand (closed while dragged), a link's hand, else the arrow.
x-og-variants.none: Hidden (a game drawing its own).

ElementProps.description: Everything an element carries beyond its box (docs/ui.md §6.1): set with og.ui.props right after the element. The zero value is an element in the flow, unmoved and opaque, with no motion.

opacity.description: Its opacity, multiplied down the tree.

z.description: Its drawing and hit-testing order among its siblings: higher draws over lower without leaving the flow.

insets.description: Its insets, for an absolute or anchored element.

anchorTo.description: The path of the element an anchored element is placed against.

anchorAt.description: The target's point it sits on.

anchorSelf.description: Its own point that sits there.

hitSlop.description: Extra pointer reach around its box.

layout.description: How it lays out its children.

grid.description: Its tracks and areas, for a grid.

place.description: Its place in a grid parent.

container.description: Its container queries read its own width.

variants.description: Prop overrides by breakpoint, orientation and width; later ones win.

overlaps.description: Paths of elements it overlaps on purpose (an ancestor path covers its subtree; `*` covers everything, for what follows the pointer across the screen: a targeting arc, a dragged ghost). Undeclared overlaps are reported (og.ui.overlaps).

dense.description: Its text and its subtree's are a dense HUD's readouts (strategy, MMO, simulation: docs/ui.md §15.2): og ui check holds them to 12 px at 1080p instead of 18, still growing with the player's text scale and passing the contrast rule. Never for menus, body text or controls.

match.description: A shared-element key: the element with the same key on the screen being left morphs into this one.

pinch.description: Two touches scale and turn it.

nav.description: Where keys and pads move the focus from it, over the spatial pick.

focusGroup.description: Its focusable controls are one focus group: arrows move among them first; at its edge it wraps or is left; it can remember its last member.

gestures.description: Tap, double tap and long press on it.

cursor.description: The pointer's shape over it and its subtree; auto takes its parent's.

customize.description: The player can move, scale and fade it in the HUD edit mode (og.ui.setHudEdit); its placement applies on every frame (og.ui.setHudLayout).

motion.description: How its animatable values move when they change; null is at once.

layoutMotion.description: Moves from its last laid-out rectangle to its new one (FLIP); null jumps.

exit.description: How it leaves: kept, inert and out of hit tests and the accessibility tree, while it plays after the element leaves the tree.

state.description: The current state of its groups that are not derived from input.

reduced.description: Its reduced-motion fallback; null is the style's.

inert.description: It and its subtree take no input.

EaseKey.description: A named ease into a key.

HoldKey.description: Holds the previous value, then jumps at the key.

BezierKey.description: A cubic Bézier into the key.

KeyEase.description: How the segment into a key moves.

oneOf.description: On a spring from the previous key's value (released at it).

durationMs.description: About how long it takes to arrive, ms.

bounce.description: 0 arrives without overshoot; 0.3 overshoots a little; up to 1 rings (below 0 is sluggish). The style's overshoot caps it.

TimelineKey.description: A keyframe: a value at a time.

ease.description: How the segment into it moves; null is the out ease.

TimelineTrack.description: Keys over one prop of the element the timeline plays on, or of a descendant by its path below it (`Stars/Star#2`). Before its first key it holds that key's value, after its last the last.

target.description: A path below the play's element (empty: the element itself).

SoundEvent.description: A UI sound of the style.

name.description: hover, press, open, close, success or error.

pitch.description: Its pitch (1: as recorded); a cascade step raises it 6 %.

HapticEvent.description: A haptic pattern for the host.

name.description: light, medium, heavy, success, warning or error.

BurstEvent.description: Rays and sparks from the target.

radius.description: How far they reach (0: the style's).

color.description: Their colour; null is the style's highlight.

StateEvent.description: Sets a state group of the target.

CallbackEvent.description: A callback to game code: it arrives in og.ui.motionEvents.

name.description: Its name.

TimelineAction.description: What an event does when a play reaches it.

name.description: hover, press, open, close, success or error.

pitch.description: Its pitch (1: as recorded); a cascade step raises it 6 %.

name.description: light, medium, heavy, success, warning or error.

radius.description: How far they reach (0: the style's).

color.description: Their colour; null is the style's highlight.

name.description: Its name.

TimelineEvent.description: An event at a time, on the play's element or a descendant.

target.description: A path below the play's element (empty: the element itself).

name.description: Its name.

durationMs.description: Its length (0: its last key or event).

ChoreoPlay.description: A timeline on the play's element or a descendant.

target.description: A path below the play's element (empty: the element itself).

ChoreoStagger.description: One timeline on each target, each stepMs after the one before as ordered by from, the whole spread within capMs.

targets.description: Paths below the play's element (empty: its children in order).

stepMs.description: Between one target's start and the next's (0: the style's stagger).

capMs.description: The most the whole stagger spreads over (0: the style's cap).

from.description: Where delays grow from: start, end, center (nearest the centre of their bounds first), or `x,y` (nearest that point first).

ChoreoCascade.description: Steps where each starts at the first `on` callback event of the one before (or its end): a score that counts chips, then multiplies, each step pitched higher.

on.description: The callback that starts the next step.

target.description: A path below the play's element (empty: the element itself).

targets.description: Paths below the play's element (empty: its children in order).

stepMs.description: Between one target's start and the next's (0: the style's stagger).

capMs.description: The most the whole stagger spreads over (0: the style's cap).

from.description: Where delays grow from: start, end, center (nearest the centre of their bounds first), or `x,y` (nearest that point first).

on.description: The callback that starts the next step.

fromLabel.description: Start at a label of its first timeline (wins over fromMs).

hold.description: Keep the last values once it ends, until stopped.

decorative.description: Under reduced motion it does not play at all.

ended.description: Finished (a held play keeps its values).

GestureInfo.description: What a drag or pinch on an element is doing (last tick's answer, as responses are).

held.description: A press is held on it.

dragging.description: It moves with the pointer (the press travelled past the threshold).

offsetX.description: Its offset from where it was laid out.

snapped.description: The snap point the last release chose (-1: none).

over.description: The drop target under the drag (empty: none).

droppedOn.description: The drop target it was dropped on this tick (empty: none).

hovering.description: For a drop target: a drag is over it.

received.description: For a drop target: the element dropped on it this tick (empty: none).

tapped.description: Its tap this tick (ElementProps.gestures), as Response.tapped.

longPress.description: How far into its long press the held press is, 0 to 1.

UiMotionEvent.description: What happened in the UI's motion this tick.

kind.description: sound, haptic, burst, state, callback, end (a play finished), dismiss (a swipe threw an element off), drop (a drag was dropped on a target), snap (a released drag chose a snap point), or tap, doubleTap and longPress (an element's ElementProps.gestures recognised one).

name.description: The sound, haptic, callback or state's name; for drop the target's path; for snap the point's index.

target.description: The element's path.

index.description: The clip's step in a cascade or stagger.

pitch.description: A sound's pitch: its own times 1.06 per cascade step.

UiOverlap.description: Two elements overlapping where neither declared it (docs/ui.md §6.2).

path.description: The element placed over the other (absolute, anchored or floating), or the later of two siblings in the flow.

inFlow.description: Both are in their parent's flow: a layout bug, not a placement.

UiLayoutStats.description: What the last frame rebuilt and laid out (docs/ui.md §6.3).

rebuilt.description: Elements whose inputs changed since the tick before (or are new).

laidOut.description: Elements laid out; the rest kept their last layout.

keptCommands.description: Elements whose draw commands were kept from the tick before.

NotificationVariant.description: What a notification is, which sets its look, sound and default time.

x-og-variants.standard: A plain message: a tone's accent and icon well (4 s).
x-og-variants.achievement: An achievement: a medal well in gold, an eyebrow over the title, points (6 s); plays reward.
x-og-variants.reward: An item or currency received: the icon well glows in the rarity's colour (5 s); plays reward.
x-og-variants.alert: A warning that must be read: danger accent, read at once by a screen reader (8 s); plays warning.
x-og-variants.social: A friend, invite or message: a round avatar slot (5 s).

Rarity.description: A loot tier (the style's rarity colours, each paired with its pips so no tier is told by colour alone).

x-og-variants.none: No tier.

NotificationItem.description: One notification of a stack, as the game's viewmodel holds it. The game appends one when something happens and drops the keys the stack reports expired or dismissed.

key.description: Its key, stable while it lives (also its probe id): posting a key again with a higher count merges it (×3).

title.description: The headline.

body.description: A line under it; empty is none (two lines at most, then an ellipsis).

eyebrow.description: A small line over the title (Achievement unlocked); empty is none.

icon.description: An icon of the atlas in its well; empty draws the tone's mark.

image.description: An art slot in the well instead of the icon (an item, an avatar).

tone.description: Its tone: the accent edge and the icon well.

rarity.description: A reward's tier: the well's glow and pips.

at.description: og.ui.tick() when it was posted: its time runs from when it first shows (a queued one waits).

durationMs.description: How long it shows; 0 is the variant's time.

sticky.description: It stays until dismissed or its action is pressed.

count.description: How many times it happened (a ×3 chip from 2 on).

progress.description: A progress bar under the body, 0 to 1 (an achievement 3 of 10 of the way).

progressText.description: The progress in words (3 / 10); empty is none.

points.description: A value at the end (+50 G, 120 XP); empty is none.

action.description: A button's label (Accept, View); empty is none.

NotificationsDesc.description: A stack of notifications (toasts) anchored in the safe area.

items.description: The game's notifications, oldest first; past their time they leave on their own.

anchor.description: Where the stack sits; the default is the top right (the top centre on a phone in portrait).

max.description: The most shown at once (later ones queue); 0 is 3 (2 on a phone).

width.description: A card's width; 0 is 380 (the safe area's width less its gutters on a phone in portrait).

dismissLabel.description: What a screen reader calls the swipe or press that dismisses one.

NotificationsResult.description: What a notification stack answered this tick.

expired.description: Keys whose time ran out this tick: drop them from the viewmodel.

dismissed.description: Keys the player dismissed (a press on the card, a swipe, Back while it had focus).

action.description: The key whose action button was pressed this tick.

shown.description: The keys on screen, newest first.

CountBadgeDesc.description: A count badge on the corner of the container it is built in (a tab, an inventory icon, a mailbox button).

count.description: The count; 0 hides a count badge.

max.description: Past this it shows max+; 0 is 99.

text.description: The label badge's word.

tone.description: Its tone; the default is danger, the convention for unread counts.

corner.description: The corner of the container it sits on: topRight is the end side's top (mirrored right to left).

pulse.description: Pulse once when the count rises (the default).

name.description: What a screen reader says (3 unread); empty is the count.

TooltipStat.description: A row of a tooltip's stats, with an optional comparison.

label.description: What it is (Damage).

delta.description: Against what is compared (the equipped item): positive is better, drawn with an up mark in success; negative with a down mark in danger; 0 none.

deltaText.description: The delta as shown (+12); empty formats delta.

better.description: Higher is worse for this stat (a cooldown): flips the marks' colours.

TooltipLink.description: What a keyword link in a tooltip's body opens: a nested tooltip of its own.

key.description: The `[link=key]` id in the body.

title.description: Its title.

body.description: Its body: rich text, with links of its own.

TooltipCardDesc.description: A rich tooltip card beside its trigger.

open.description: The trigger is hovered or focused (its Response's hovered or focused): it shows after delayMs and stays while open, while pinned, or while the pointer is over it.

target.description: The trigger's path; a bare id names an element of the open container (built before this call). Empty places it at the pointer's last trigger rectangle of this tooltip.

title.description: The title.

subtitle.description: A line under it (Legendary sword, Passive).

icon.description: An icon of the atlas beside the title.

image.description: An art slot instead of the icon (item or ability icon, 1:1).

body.description: The body: rich text markup (og.ui.richText), its `[link=key]keyword[/link]` spans opening nested tooltips from links.

compareTitle.description: With comparison deltas: the heading over a second card of what is equipped (Equipped); empty draws no second card.

compareStats.description: The equipped item's stats, in the second card.

footer.description: A last line (Sell for 120, a flavour quote) in the muted ink.

hints.description: Action hints (Right-click to equip), each with its action's glyph when one is named [action:equip].

delayMs.description: Rest before it shows; 0 is the style's slow duration.

pinnable.description: It locks open: after pinMs of rest a ring fills on its corner and it stays when the pointer leaves the trigger, until the pointer leaves the card (as Paradox's games do); the pin action (middle mouse, T, a pad's Y) pins at once. Nested tooltips are always pinnable.

width.description: Its width; 0 is 320 (300 on a phone).

placement.description: Where it prefers to sit against the trigger: right (the end side), left, top or bottom. It sits beside the whole group the trigger is in (the panel or column, so it never covers its own trigger's panel) when there is room on either side of it, else beside the trigger; it flips and clamps to stay inside the safe area.

pinLabel.description: The pin hint under a pinned card.

TooltipCardResult.description: What a tooltip card did this tick.

link.description: The link pressed in it (or in a nested card) this tick: its key.

depth.description: How many nested cards are open beneath it.

ProgressStyle.description: How a progress bar shows its value.

x-og-variants.bar: A track filled from its start.
x-og-variants.steps: Equal segments, each filled whole as the value passes it (a level's stages).
x-og-variants.indeterminate: No value: a band sweeping along the track (loading of unknown length).

buffer.description: A second, paler fill ahead of value (downloaded, ahead of installed), 0 to 1.

steps.description: For style steps: how many; 0 is 5.

label.description: A caption over it at the start (Downloading); empty is none.

valueText.description: The value in words at the end (2.1 of 4.5 GB); empty is the percent, with showValue.

showValue.description: Show the value at the end.

tone.description: Its fill's tone; neutral is the primary.

thickness.description: The track's height; 0 is 8 (6 on a phone).

sheen.description: A highlight sweeps over the fill while it is short of done (still under reduced motion it stops).

size.description: Its diameter; 0 is 48.

thickness.description: The ring's width; 0 is a tenth of the size, at least 3.

tone.description: The fill's tone; neutral is the primary.

label.description: Text in the middle; empty is the percent for a value (none for a spinner), and none when the ring is under 40 px.

name.description: What a screen reader calls it (Loading); empty is Progress.

SkeletonShape.description: What a skeleton stands in for.

x-og-variants.lines: Lines of text: the last one shorter.
x-og-variants.card: A card: an art block, a title and two lines.
x-og-variants.row: A list row: an avatar, a title and a line.
x-og-variants.block: A block of the given size.

SkeletonGroupDesc.description: A skeleton standing in for content that is loading.

height.description: A block's or a card's art height; 0 is 120.

name.description: What a screen reader says while it loads.

x-og-variants.compact: Shortened past 9,999 to three significant digits with K, M, B, T, then scientific (12.8M).
x-og-variants.letters: Shortened as idle games do: K, M, B, T, then aa, ab, … az, ba … (1.25ab), never running out.
x-og-variants.engineering: As scientific with the exponent a multiple of three (12.8e6).

NumberFormatDesc.description: How og.ui.formatNumber and the counters write a number.

decimals.description: Digits after the point; null is none below 10,000 and three significant digits in the shortened forms.

exponent.description: The value is value × 10^exponent: numbers past 1e308 (an idle game's 1.5e420 is value 1.5, exponent 420).

NumberCounterDesc.description: A big number that counts to its value.

step.description: The type step; null is xl3.

font.description: The font; the default is mono (tabular digits that do not jitter).

color.description: The ink; null is ink.

label.description: A caption under it (Score, Gold); empty is none.

icon.description: An icon of the atlas before it (coin); empty is none.

roll.description: Each digit rolls to its next like an odometer while it counts (the default); off, the number counts in place.

durationMs.description: How long a change takes to count; 0 is 600 ms (a rise of more than a tenth takes up to 1.2 s).

delta.description: A rise throws its +n off the number, rising and fading (the default).

ticks.description: Play counterTick as it counts, pitched higher through the count.

anchor.description: Opens its own anchored group there (on the HUD chip); null builds it in place.

align.description: How it aligns in its column.

BannerKind.description: What a banner announces, which sets its look and timing.

x-og-variants.title: A title card: an area or chapter name over a thin rule (Elden Ring's place names), slow fade (3 s).
x-og-variants.wave: A wave or round: a band across the screen with a large title that slams in (2.4 s).
x-og-variants.victory: A win: a gold band with a burst (3.5 s); plays success.
x-og-variants.defeat: A loss: a dark band in danger (3.5 s); plays error.
x-og-variants.warning: A warning across the screen (Boss approaching): danger stripes that pulse (3 s); plays warning.

title.description: The big line.

eyebrow.description: A small line over it (Chapter II, Wave).

shownAt.description: og.ui.tick() when it should start: a later tick restarts it. Past its time it is gone.

durationMs.description: How long it holds before it leaves; 0 is the kind's.

anchor.description: Where it sits; the default is the centre.
